title: Hybrid AI Patterns: Thirteen Ways to Couple Language Models with Rules, and How to Choose Among Them
title_zh: 混合式AI模式：语言模型与规则耦合的十三种方式，以及如何选择

paragraphs.en: Language models handle text well, and rule engines give conclusions with proofs. Systems that combine the two are usually described by example, and the same coupling turns up under different names in agent frameworks, guardrail toolkits and neuro-symbolic research. This document defines thirteen patterns for coupling a language model with an executable rule language, in the catalogue form introduced for object-oriented design: intent, motivation, applicability, participants, collaborations, consequences, implementation, known uses and related patterns. Four patterns concern what crosses the boundary between model and rules, five who controls whom, three how the model takes part in the reasoning, and one how knowledge is kept over time. Five invariants hold for every combination, and five failure patterns name the couplings that break them. We relate the catalogue to published pattern catalogues and taxonomies of hybrid and neuro-symbolic systems and show where they overlap with it. A decision guide leads from a problem to a pattern. It rests on our measurements, including the cases in which a model alone did as well as the hybrid or better, and it reports what each design cost.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型擅长处理文本，规则引擎则能给出带证明的结论。 将两者结合的系统通常以示例方式描述，同样的耦合在智能体框架、护栏工具包和神经符号研究中以不同名称反复出现。 本文档以面向对象设计所采用的目录形式，定义了将语言模型与可执行规则语言相耦合的十三个模式：意图、动机、适用性、参与者、协作、效果、实现、已知应用及相关模式。 四个模式关注什么跨越模型与规则之间的边界，五个关注谁控制谁，三个关注模型如何参与推理，一个关注知识如何随时间保存。 五个不变式对所有组合均成立，五个失效模式则命名了破坏这些不变式的耦合。 我们将该目录与已发表的模式目录以及混合系统和神经符号系统的分类法联系起来，并展示它们与本目录的重叠之处。 一份决策指南可从问题引导至相应的模式。 它基于我们的测量，包括模型单独表现与混合系统相当甚至更好的情形，并报告了每种设计的成本。

paragraphs.en: More and more organisations let language models act on documents, conversations and transactions that are governed by explicit rules: a regulation, a protocol, an authority limit. Two designs are possible. The rules can be written into the prompt and the model asked to apply them, or the rules can stay executable and the model be given the parts of the task that rules cannot do: reading text, phrasing a question, proposing a candidate. Between these two designs lie many couplings, and practitioners tend to reinvent them project by project.
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的组织让语言模型处理由明确规则约束的文档、对话和交易：这些规则可以是法规、协议或权限限制。 有两种可能的设计。 可以把规则写进提示词并要求模型执行这些规则，也可以让规则保持可执行状态，只把规则无法完成的部分任务交给模型：阅读文本、拟定问题、提出候选方案。 这两种设计之间存在许多耦合方式，而从业者往往在每个项目中重新发明它们。

paragraphs.en: A pattern names a recurring problem in a context and the core of a solution that can be reused without being copied ( Alexander et al., 1977 ) . The catalogue form of Gamma et al. (1994) made patterns a working vocabulary for object-oriented design, and Buschmann et al. (1996) carried it to the architecture of whole systems: each pattern has a name, an intent, a motivating example, conditions of applicability, a structure of participants and collaborations, consequences, notes on implementation, known uses and related patterns. We use the same form for couplings of language models with rules. A shared name lets designers say which coupling they mean. The consequences make the trade-offs explicit, including the cases where a model alone is the better choice, and the known uses tie each pattern to running systems and to measurements.
paragraphs.zh: 模式是在特定语境中命名一个反复出现的问题以及可被复用而非照搬的解决方案的核心（Alexander 等，1977）。 Gamma 等人的目录式体例。 （1994）使模式成为面向对象设计的工作词汇，而 Buschmann 等人。 （1996）将其推广到整个系统的架构：每个模式都有一个名称、一个意图、一个动机示例、适用条件、参与者与协作的结构、结果、实现说明、已知用途以及相关模式。 我们对语言模型与规则的耦合采用同样的体例。 一个共享的名称让设计者能够说明他们指的是哪种耦合。 结果部分使权衡变得明确，包括仅使用模型是更好选择的情况，而已知用途则将每个模式与实际运行的系统和度量数据联系起来。

paragraphs.en: The patterns were found in the applications of FrameX, a rule and knowledge engine based on F-Logic ( Kifer et al., 1995 ) , and checked against published catalogues ( Section 9 ). They do not depend on FrameX: any rule engine that can request a model call, store the answer as data and derive conclusions over it can host them. The examples use FrameX’s notation because we made the measurements in it. An early version of the FrameX engine and framework is publicly available at https://gitlab.com/ds-unisg/framex-core ; a full release is forthcoming.
paragraphs.zh: 这些模式是在 FrameX（一个基于 F-Logic 的规则与知识引擎，Kifer 等，1995）的应用中发现的，并与已发表的目录进行了比对（第 9 节）。 它们不依赖于 FrameX：任何能够发起模型调用、将答案存储为数据并在其之上推导结论的规则引擎都可以承载这些模式。 示例使用 FrameX 的记法，因为我们的测量是在其中进行的。 FrameX 引擎与框架的早期版本已在 https://gitlab.com/ds-unisg/framex-core 上公开；完整版本即将发布。

paragraphs.en: The following contributions are made in this document:
paragraphs.zh: 本文做出了以下贡献：

paragraphs.en: 1: Thirteen patterns in catalogue form, composed from four elementary moves, with five invariants that hold for all of them ( Sections 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 and 6 ), and five failure patterns that break the invariants ( Section 8 ).
paragraphs.zh: 1: 以目录形式呈现的十三个模式，由四种基本动作组合而成，具有对所有模式都成立的五个不变量（第2、3、4、5和6节），以及五个破坏不变量的失败模式（第8节）。

paragraphs.en: 2: A mapping onto published pattern catalogues and taxonomies that shows which patterns are known, which are new, and which published patterns this catalogue lacks ( Section 9 ).
paragraphs.zh: 2：到已发表模式目录和分类法的映射，说明哪些模式是已知的，哪些是新的，以及该目录缺少哪些已发表的模式（第 9 节）。

paragraphs.en: 3: A decision guide from problem to pattern, grounded in pre-registered measurements ( Section 10 ).
paragraphs.zh: 3: 一份从问题到模式的决策指南，以预注册的测量为基础（第 10 节）。

paragraphs.en: The listings use FrameX, a rule language in the F-Logic tradition. We assume that the reader knows its basic syntax: frames ?X:Class[slot -> ?V] , rules head <- body , AND , NOT , queries ?- … , and the open-world reading of unknown . Every program declares its world. Under world open. a missing fact is unknown , and NOT gives true only over a slot, method or class declared closed ( closed slot allowsSlot. , closed method refuted/1. , where /1 is the number of parameters, closed class Admitted. ); over anything else the negation stays unknown . The programs also compute values ( ?M := ?N + 1 ), compare them ( < , > , != ), use methods with parameters ( slot(?I) -> ?V ) and strings as objects ( "mbi":Programme ), and write an object whose name is a term in backquotes ( `read(d1)` ). This section introduces only what coupling with a model adds. All thirteen patterns rest on it.
paragraphs.zh: 这些清单使用 FrameX，这是一种沿袭 F-Logic 传统的规则语言。 我们假设读者已了解其基本语法：框架 ?X:Class[slot -> ?V]、规则 head <- body、AND、NOT、查询 ?- …，以及对 unknown 的开放世界解读。 每个程序都声明自己的世界。 在 world open. 之下，缺失的事实是 unknown，而 NOT 只有在声明为封闭的槽、方法或类之上才得出真（closed slot allowsSlot.、closed method refuted/1.，其中 /1 是参数个数、closed class Admitted.）；对于其他任何对象，否定仍为 unknown。 这些程序还计算值（?M := ?N + 1）、比较它们（<、>、!=）、使用带参数的方法（slot(?I) -> ?V）以及作为对象的字符串（"mbi":Programme），并写出名称为反引号中一项的对象（`read(d1)`）。 本节只介绍与模型耦合所带来的内容。 全部十三个模式都以此为基础。

paragraphs.en: A rule asks for something outside the engine with the keyword external :
paragraphs.zh: 规则使用关键字 external 向引擎外部请求某些内容：

paragraphs.en: The engine evaluates this rule like any other. Its conclusion is a request: an object `read(d1)` with the fields in brackets as attributes, the tool ( tool#name -> "_llm" ), a mark tool#requested -> true , and link facts for the request’s arguments ( tool#arg1 -> d1 , and tool#arg2 for a second argument). The engine never calls a network. A host , a program beside the engine, reads the open requests, runs the tool and adds its answer as a receipt ; the engine then recomputes, and rules that read the receipt can fire, including rules that issue the next request. The keyword is kept although the tool name would identify a request, because such a rule follows other laws than a derivation: a request is carried out at most once in a run and is never withdrawn, whereas a derived fact disappears when its premises do. Every point at which a program reaches outside the engine is marked by it.
paragraphs.zh: 引擎像对待其他规则一样评估这条规则。 它的结论是一个请求：一个对象 read(d1)，括号中的字段作为属性，工具 ( tool#name -> "_llm" )，一个标记 tool#requested -> true，以及请求参数的链接事实（ tool#arg1 -> d1 ，第二个参数则用 tool#arg2 ）。 引擎从不调用网络。 宿主是引擎旁边的一个程序，它读取未处理的请求，运行工具，并把答案作为回执加入；随后引擎重新计算，读取该回执的规则可以触发，包括发出下一个请求的规则。 尽管工具名称本身已能标识一个请求，这个关键字仍被保留，因为这样的规则遵循的法则与推导不同：一个请求在一次运行中至多执行一次且从不被撤回，而推导出的事实会随其前提的消失而消失。 程序触及引擎之外的每个位置都由它加以标记。

paragraphs.en: An answer returns as facts about the request object:
paragraphs.zh: 一个回答以关于请求对象的事实形式返回：

paragraphs.en: A scalar answer field key becomes result("key") ; the reserved field rows , a list of at most 64 flat objects, becomes row(N, "key") . Every receipt ends with tool#completed -> true and tool#status , which is "succeeded" or "failed" . A failed call (the model did not answer in time, the reply was not valid JSON, a field the host needs was missing) adds no result and no row , only an attribute error with the reason, `read(d1)`[error -> "model response is not valid JSON; no facts accepted"] . A rule that reads tool#status -> "failed" keeps such a case apart from a rejection (invariant 5). Answers must be flat: values are stored as literals and never evaluated, nested objects and lists are refused, and a null states nothing. Rules usually key rows by method parameters ( ?D[slot(?I) -> …] ); since FrameX allows function terms in rule heads, a rule can also give each row an object of its own, st(?U, ?I):Statement[…] ( Section 6.1 ). Table 2 lists what each tool reads from a request and writes into its receipt.
paragraphs.zh: 标量答案字段键变为 result("key")；保留字段 rows 是一个至多包含 64 个扁平对象的列表，变为 row(N, "key")。 每个回执都以 tool#completed -> true 和 tool#status 结尾，其中 tool#status 的值为 "succeeded" 或 "failed"。 失败的调用（模型未及时回答、回复不是有效的 JSON、缺少宿主所需的字段）不会添加任何 result 和 row，只会添加一个带原因的属性 error，即 `read(d1)`[error -> "model response is not valid JSON; no facts accepted"]。 读取 tool#status -> "failed" 的规则可将此类情况与拒绝（不变式 5）区分开来。 答案必须是扁平的：值以字面量形式存储且从不被求值，嵌套对象和列表会被拒绝，null 不表示任何内容。 规则通常以方法参数作为行的键（ ?D[slot(?I) -> …] ）；由于 FrameX 允许在规则头部使用函数项，规则也可以为每一行赋予其自己的对象，即 st(?U, ?I):Statement[…]（ 第 6.1 节 ）。 表 2 列出了每个工具从请求中读取什么，以及向其回执中写入什么。

sents.en: Every receipt ends with tool#completed -> true and tool#status , which is "succeeded" or "failed" .
sents.zh: 每个回执都以 tool#completed -> true 和 tool#status 结尾，其中 tool#status 的值为 "succeeded" 或 "failed"。

sents.en: A failed call (the model did not answer in time, the reply was not valid JSON, a field the host needs was missing) adds no result and no row , only an attribute error with the reason, `read(d1)`[error -> "model response is not valid JSON; no facts accepted"] .
sents.zh: 失败的调用（模型未及时回答、回复不是有效的 JSON、缺少宿主所需的字段）不会添加任何 result 和 row，只会添加一个带原因的属性 error，即 `read(d1)`[error -> "model response is not valid JSON; no facts accepted"]。

sents.en: A rule that reads tool#status -> "failed" keeps such a case apart from a rejection (invariant 5).
sents.zh: 读取 tool#status -> "failed" 的规则可将此类情况与拒绝（不变式 5）区分开来。

sents.en: Answers must be flat: values are stored as literals and never evaluated, nested objects and lists are refused, and a null states nothing.
sents.zh: 答案必须是扁平的：值以字面量形式存储且从不被求值，嵌套对象和列表会被拒绝，null 不表示任何内容。

sents.en: Rules usually key rows by method parameters ( ?D[slot(?I) -> …] ); since FrameX allows function terms in rule heads, a rule can also give each row an object of its own, st(?U, ?I):Statement[…] ( Section 6.1 ).
sents.zh: 规则通常以方法参数作为行的键（ ?D[slot(?I) -> …] ）；由于 FrameX 允许在规则头部使用函数项，规则也可以为每一行赋予其自己的对象，即 st(?U, ?I):Statement[…]（ 第 6.1 节 ）。

sents.en: Table 2 lists what each tool reads from a request and writes into its receipt.
sents.zh: 表 2 列出了每个工具从请求中读取什么，以及向其回执中写入什么。

paragraphs.en: A request is identified by its name and arguments. read(d1) runs once; a second attempt needs a new identity, as in propose(?T, ?N) with a step number ( Section 4.1 ). A request without arguments, external propose using … , is the object propose itself, and its receipt is read as propose[…] ( Section 5.1 ). Instances of one request name form a queue; requests of different names that are open at the same time need tool#order -> N , and the lowest goes first. Two values for one request field are an error. A run ends when a rule derives workflow[status -> …] or when no request is open.
paragraphs.zh: 请求由其名称和参数标识。read(d1) 只运行一次；再次尝试需要新的标识，例如带步骤编号的 propose(?T, ?N)（见 4.1 节）。 无参数的请求（即使用 … 的外部 propose）就是对象 propose 本身，其回执读作 propose[…]（见 5.1 节）。 同一请求名称的实例构成一个队列；不同名称且同时处于打开状态的请求需要 tool#order -> N，编号最小的最先执行。 同一请求字段出现两个值是一种错误。 当某条规则推导出 workflow[status -> …]，或没有任何请求处于打开状态时，一次运行即告结束。

sents.en: A request is identified by its name and arguments. read(d1) runs once; a second attempt needs a new identity, as in propose(?T, ?N) with a step number ( Section 4.1 ).
sents.zh: 请求由其名称和参数标识。read(d1) 只运行一次；再次尝试需要新的标识，例如带步骤编号的 propose(?T, ?N)（见 4.1 节）。

sents.en: A request without arguments, external propose using … , is the object propose itself, and its receipt is read as propose[…] ( Section 5.1 ).
sents.zh: 无参数的请求（即使用 … 的外部 propose）就是对象 propose 本身，其回执读作 propose[…]（见 5.1 节）。

sents.en: Instances of one request name form a queue; requests of different names that are open at the same time need tool#order -> N , and the lowest goes first.
sents.zh: 同一请求名称的实例构成一个队列；不同名称且同时处于打开状态的请求需要 tool#order -> N，编号最小的最先执行。

sents.en: Two values for one request field are an error.
sents.zh: 同一请求字段出现两个值是一种错误。

sents.en: A run ends when a rule derives workflow[status -> …] or when no request is open.
sents.zh: 当某条规则推导出 workflow[status -> …]，或没有任何请求处于打开状态时，一次运行即告结束。

paragraphs.en: The tool after using names what the host does ( Table 1 ). Tools beyond those shipped with FrameX come from adapter files that the operator names when starting the host; a program can never load code.
paragraphs.zh: 使用后，该工具以名称标明主机所做的操作（表 1）。 FrameX 自带工具之外的其他工具来自操作者在启动智能体时指定的适配器文件；程序永远无法加载代码。

sents.en: The tool after using names what the host does ( Table 1 ).
sents.zh: 使用后，该工具以名称标明主机所做的操作（表 1）。

sents.en: Tools beyond those shipped with FrameX come from adapter files that the operator names when starting the host; a program can never load code.
sents.zh: FrameX 自带工具之外的其他工具来自操作者在启动智能体时指定的适配器文件；程序永远无法加载代码。

paragraphs.en: _llm sends prompt as the instruction and the other fields as one JSON message, so a rule hands over separate, traceable slots. Fields that start with tool# and the fields read by the host ( groundIn , mustSay , contextKey ) are not sent. Long prompts live in prompt objects ( readPrompt:Prompt[text -> "..."] ) that a request names with using _llm with readPrompt[...] . Every answer is stored with its date, model and messages and replayed on the next identical request until a refresh is asked for; a run can therefore be repeated without the model. Which model answers is set in the host’s environment (a local server or a hosted endpoint), and keys never enter programs or receipts.
paragraphs.zh: _llm 将 prompt 作为指令、将其他字段作为一条 JSON 消息发送，因此规则可以交出彼此独立、可追踪的槽位。 以 tool# 开头的字段以及宿主读取的字段（groundIn、mustSay、contextKey）不会被发送。 长提示词存放在 prompt 对象中（readPrompt:Prompt[text -> "..."]），请求通过 using _llm with readPrompt[...] 来引用它们。 每个回答都会连同其日期、模型和消息一起存储，并在下一次完全相同的请求时重放，直到要求刷新为止；因此一次运行可以在不调用模型的情况下重复进行。 由哪个模型来回答是在宿主的环境中设置的（本地服务器或托管端点），密钥永远不会进入程序或回执。

sents.en: _llm sends prompt as the instruction and the other fields as one JSON message, so a rule hands over separate, traceable slots.
sents.zh: _llm 将 prompt 作为指令、将其他字段作为一条 JSON 消息发送，因此规则可以交出彼此独立、可追踪的槽位。

sents.en: Fields that start with tool# and the fields read by the host ( groundIn , mustSay , contextKey ) are not sent.
sents.zh: 以 tool# 开头的字段以及宿主读取的字段（groundIn、mustSay、contextKey）不会被发送。

sents.en: Long prompts live in prompt objects ( readPrompt:Prompt[text -> "..."] ) that a request names with using _llm with readPrompt[...] .
sents.zh: 长提示词存放在 prompt 对象中（readPrompt:Prompt[text -> "..."]），请求通过 using _llm with readPrompt[...] 来引用它们。

sents.en: Every answer is stored with its date, model and messages and replayed on the next identical request until a refresh is asked for; a run can therefore be repeated without the model.
sents.zh: 每个回答都会连同其日期、模型和消息一起存储，并在下一次完全相同的请求时重放，直到要求刷新为止；因此一次运行可以在不调用模型的情况下重复进行。

sents.en: Which model answers is set in the host’s environment (a local server or a hosted endpoint), and keys never enter programs or receipts.
sents.zh: 由哪个模型来回答是在宿主的环境中设置的（本地服务器或托管端点），密钥永远不会进入程序或回执。

paragraphs.en: Two request fields are read by the host and never shown to the model. With groundIn -> ?Text , every answer row gets quoteFound (its quote occurs verbatim in that text) and valueQuoted (its value occurs in its quote). With mustSay -> ?Word , the receipt gets saysDecision (the reply contains the word). Both are measurements; whether a row or a reply counts is decided by rules.
paragraphs.zh: 两个请求字段由主机读取，从不会展示给模型。 设置 groundIn -> ?Text 时，每个答案行都会获得 quoteFound（其引文逐字出现在该文本中）和 valueQuoted（其值出现在其引文中）。 设置 mustSay -> ?Word 时，回执会获得 saysDecision（回复中包含该词）。 两者都是测量项；某一行或某个回复是否算数由规则决定。

sents.en: Two request fields are read by the host and never shown to the model.
sents.zh: 两个请求字段由主机读取，从不会展示给模型。

sents.en: With groundIn -> ?Text , every answer row gets quoteFound (its quote occurs verbatim in that text) and valueQuoted (its value occurs in its quote).
sents.zh: 设置 groundIn -> ?Text 时，每个答案行都会获得 quoteFound（其引文逐字出现在该文本中）和 valueQuoted（其值出现在其引文中）。

sents.en: With mustSay -> ?Word , the receipt gets saysDecision (the reply contains the word).
sents.zh: 设置 mustSay -> ?Word 时，回执会获得 saysDecision（回复中包含该词）。

sents.en: Both are measurements; whether a row or a reply counts is decided by rules.
sents.zh: 两者都是测量项；某一行或某个回复是否算数由规则决定。

paragraphs.en: A request with contextKey -> ?Step receives in its field context exactly the statements that rules select with ?S[selectedFor -> step] , ordered by identifier and at most tool#maxContext of them; more makes the call fail. Each statement goes to the model as one JSON object with its identifier ( id , the object’s printed name, such as st(u2, 1) ) and its slots; the default limit is 32. The receipt records only the identifiers of what was sent, as tool#sent("st(u2, 1)") -> st(u2, 1) . A reply cites statements by identifier in its rows, so rules can check that every cited statement was sent and is current ( Section 6.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 带有 contextKey -> ?Step 的请求，其 context 字段中收到的恰好是规则用 ?S[selectedFor -> step] 选出的那些陈述，按标识符排序，且最多 tool#maxContext 条；超出会导致调用失败。 每条陈述以一个 JSON 对象的形式发给模型，包含其标识符（id，即该对象的打印名称，例如 st(u2, 1)）及其槽位；默认上限为 32。 回执只记录已发送内容的标识符，形如 tool#sent("st(u2, 1)") -> st(u2, 1)。 回复在其行中通过标识符引用陈述，因此规则可以检查每个被引用的陈述都已被发送且仍然有效（见第 6.1 节）。

sents.en: A request with contextKey -> ?Step receives in its field context exactly the statements that rules select with ?S[selectedFor -> step] , ordered by identifier and at most tool#maxContext of them; more makes the call fail.
sents.zh: 带有 contextKey -> ?Step 的请求，其 context 字段中收到的恰好是规则用 ?S[selectedFor -> step] 选出的那些陈述，按标识符排序，且最多 tool#maxContext 条；超出会导致调用失败。

sents.en: Each statement goes to the model as one JSON object with its identifier ( id , the object’s printed name, such as st(u2, 1) ) and its slots; the default limit is 32.
sents.zh: 每条陈述以一个 JSON 对象的形式发给模型，包含其标识符（id，即该对象的打印名称，例如 st(u2, 1)）及其槽位；默认上限为 32。

sents.en: The receipt records only the identifiers of what was sent, as tool#sent("st(u2, 1)") -> st(u2, 1) .
sents.zh: 回执只记录已发送内容的标识符，形如 tool#sent("st(u2, 1)") -> st(u2, 1)。

sents.en: A reply cites statements by identifier in its rows, so rules can check that every cited statement was sent and is current ( Section 6.1 ).
sents.zh: 回复在其行中通过标识符引用陈述，因此规则可以检查每个被引用的陈述都已被发送且仍然有效（见第 6.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: Because the fields of a request become attributes of its object, a condition without a class can match the request itself: ?Q[decision -> ?D] also matches `phrase(q1)` when that request has a field decision . FrameX stops such a run and names the cause. A field named like a slot that rules derive for the receipt gives it two values; framex validate warns about it. Give rule subjects a class ( ?Q:Request[...] ) and name request fields apart from derived slots.
paragraphs.zh: 由于请求的字段会成为其对象的属性，不带类的条件可以匹配请求本身：当该请求具有字段 decision 时，?Q[decision -> ?D] 也会匹配 `phrase(q1)`。 FrameX 会停止这样的运行并指出原因。 若某个字段的名称与规则为回执推导出的槽（slot）相同，则该字段会有两个值；framex validate 会对此发出警告。 为规则主语指定一个类（?Q:Request[...]），并将请求字段与推导出的槽区分命名。

sents.en: Because the fields of a request become attributes of its object, a condition without a class can match the request itself: ?Q[decision -> ?D] also matches `phrase(q1)` when that request has a field decision .
sents.zh: 由于请求的字段会成为其对象的属性，不带类的条件可以匹配请求本身：当该请求具有字段 decision 时，?Q[decision -> ?D] 也会匹配 `phrase(q1)`。

sents.en: FrameX stops such a run and names the cause.
sents.zh: FrameX 会停止这样的运行并指出原因。

sents.en: A field named like a slot that rules derive for the receipt gives it two values; framex validate warns about it.
sents.zh: 若某个字段的名称与规则为回执推导出的槽（slot）相同，则该字段会有两个值；framex validate 会对此发出警告。

sents.en: Give rule subjects a class ( ?Q:Request[...] ) and name request fields apart from derived slots.
sents.zh: 为规则主语指定一个类（?Q:Request[...]），并将请求字段与推导出的槽区分命名。

paragraphs.en: A model can also call the rules, through a protocol of read-only operations ( query , explain , why_not , evidence_needs , validate , preview ).
paragraphs.zh: 模型还可以通过一组只读操作协议（query、explain、why_not、evidence_needs、validate、preview）来调用这些规则。

paragraphs.en: The implementation of each pattern shows the whole chain: the rule that requests the model call, the rules that read its receipt, and the rules that decide. Each program is printed in full, with its declarations, its data, its prompts and its queries; it runs against a model or, from recorded answers, without one.
paragraphs.zh: 每种模式的实现都展示了完整的链条：请求模型调用的规则、读取其回执的规则，以及做出决策的规则。 每个程序都完整打印，包括其声明、数据、提示词和查询；它既可以针对模型运行，也可以基于记录下来的答案在没有模型的情况下运行。

sents.en: The implementation of each pattern shows the whole chain: the rule that requests the model call, the rules that read its receipt, and the rules that decide.
sents.zh: 每种模式的实现都展示了完整的链条：请求模型调用的规则、读取其回执的规则，以及做出决策的规则。

sents.en: Each program is printed in full, with its declarations, its data, its prompts and its queries; it runs against a model or, from recorded answers, without one.
sents.zh: 每个程序都完整打印，包括其声明、数据、提示词和查询；它既可以针对模型运行，也可以基于记录下来的答案在没有模型的情况下运行。

paragraphs.en: Every pattern and every combination of patterns keeps five invariants.
paragraphs.zh: 每个模式以及每个模式的组合都保持五个不变式。

paragraphs.en: Model text is data. The engine never executes model-written rules or code unchecked; an answer is a receipt that rules read. A rule or query written by a model is a candidate that a check admits or refuses before it runs ( Sections 3.2 and 3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 模型文本是数据。 引擎从不未经检查就执行模型编写的规则或代码；答案是一张规则可读取的回执。 模型编写的规则或查询是一个候选对象，需在运行前由检查予以接纳或拒绝（见第 3.2 节和第 3.3 节）。

sents.en: Model text is data.
sents.zh: 模型文本是数据。

sents.en: The engine never executes model-written rules or code unchecked; an answer is a receipt that rules read.
sents.zh: 引擎从不未经检查就执行模型编写的规则或代码；答案是一张规则可读取的回执。

sents.en: A rule or query written by a model is a candidate that a check admits or refuses before it runs ( Sections 3.2 and 3.3 ).
sents.zh: 模型编写的规则或查询是一个候选对象，需在运行前由检查予以接纳或拒绝（见第 3.2 节和第 3.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Every model answer is a dated observation with its prompt, model and inputs, so a run can be replayed and audited.
paragraphs.zh: 每个标准答案都是一条带有提示词、模型和输入的带日期的观测记录，因此一次运行可以被重放和审计。

paragraphs.en: Rules decide. Whether a statement counts, which step comes next, when a task is complete: the rules derive each of these.
paragraphs.zh: 规则说了算。 一个陈述是否算数、下一步是什么、任务何时算完成：这些都由规则推导得出。

sents.en: Rules decide.
sents.zh: 规则说了算。

sents.en: Whether a statement counts, which step comes next, when a task is complete: the rules derive each of these.
sents.zh: 一个陈述是否算数、下一步是什么、任务何时算完成：这些都由规则推导得出。

paragraphs.en: Evidence decides acceptance. A model’s confidence is stored as a number. A statement is accepted on evidence the rules can check, such as a quote found in the source.
paragraphs.zh: 证据决定采纳。 模型的置信度以数字形式存储。 陈述依据规则可核验的证据被采纳，例如在来源中找到的引文。

sents.en: Evidence decides acceptance.
sents.zh: 证据决定采纳。

sents.en: A model’s confidence is stored as a number.
sents.zh: 模型的置信度以数字形式存储。

sents.en: A statement is accepted on evidence the rules can check, such as a quote found in the source.
sents.zh: 陈述依据规则可核验的证据被采纳，例如在来源中找到的引文。

paragraphs.en: Failures stay distinct. A failed call, a reply in the wrong format, an unclear judgement and a logical unknown are four different results.
paragraphs.zh: 失败保持彼此区分。 一次失败的调用、一个格式错误的回复、一次不明确的判断和一个逻辑上的未知，是四种不同的结果。

sents.en: Failures stay distinct.
sents.zh: 失败保持彼此区分。

sents.en: A failed call, a reply in the wrong format, an unclear judgement and a logical unknown are four different results.
sents.zh: 一次失败的调用、一个格式错误的回复、一次不明确的判断和一个逻辑上的未知，是四种不同的结果。

paragraphs.en: The division of labour follows from these invariants. The model handles perception, language and ambiguity. The rules handle whatever must be guaranteed, audited or explained. What passes between them is an explicit, validated record.
paragraphs.zh: 分工正是由这些不变量推导出来的。 模型负责处理感知、语言与歧义。 规则负责处理一切必须被保证、审计或解释的事项。 在两者之间传递的，是一份显式且经过验证的记录。

sents.en: The division of labour follows from these invariants.
sents.zh: 分工正是由这些不变量推导出来的。

sents.en: The model handles perception, language and ambiguity.
sents.zh: 模型负责处理感知、语言与歧义。

sents.en: The rules handle whatever must be guaranteed, audited or explained.
sents.zh: 规则负责处理一切必须被保证、审计或解释的事项。

sents.en: What passes between them is an explicit, validated record.
sents.zh: 在两者之间传递的，是一份显式且经过验证的记录。

paragraphs.en: Every pattern is assembled from four moves between the rules and the outside ( Fig. 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 每个模式都是由规则与外部之间的四种移动组装而成的（图 1）。

paragraphs.en: A rule whose conditions hold issues an external request to a model or a tool. What the model sees is what the rule puts into the request.
paragraphs.zh: 条件成立的规则会向模型或工具发出外部请求。 模型所看到的，就是规则放入请求中的内容。

sents.en: A rule whose conditions hold issues an external request to a model or a tool.
sents.zh: 条件成立的规则会向模型或工具发出外部请求。

sents.en: What the model sees is what the rule puts into the request.
sents.zh: 模型所看到的，就是规则放入请求中的内容。

paragraphs.en: The answer returns as dated facts about the request, joined to its subject through the request’s arguments. Nothing else enters the engine from outside.
paragraphs.zh: 答案以关于该请求的带日期事实的形式返回，并通过该请求的参数与其主体相关联。 没有任何其他东西从外部进入引擎。

sents.en: The answer returns as dated facts about the request, joined to its subject through the request’s arguments.
sents.zh: 答案以关于该请求的带日期事实的形式返回，并通过该请求的参数与其主体相关联。

sents.en: Nothing else enters the engine from outside.
sents.zh: 没有任何其他东西从外部进入引擎。

paragraphs.en: A rule decides whether what a receipt proposes becomes a fact, is refused with its reason, or stays unknown .
paragraphs.zh: 一条规则决定收据所提议的内容是成为事实、连同其原因被拒绝，还是保持未知。

paragraphs.en: A rule derives a question for a person, or the evidence that would settle an open goal; the answer returns as a receipt.
paragraphs.zh: 一条规则会为一个人生成一个问题，或推导出能够解决某个开放目标的证据；答案会作为回执返回。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 shows how the thirteen patterns compose the moves. They differ in what triggers the request and in what the accept move decides; Critique and Repair is the only pattern that repeats a move, under a bound.
paragraphs.zh: 表 3 展示了这十三个模式如何组合各个步。 它们的差异在于触发请求的条件以及接受步所判定的内容；Critique and Repair（批判与修复）是唯一在界限内重复某个步的模式。

sents.en: Table 3 shows how the thirteen patterns compose the moves.
sents.zh: 表 3 展示了这十三个模式如何组合各个步。

paragraphs.en: Each pattern is described under the headings of Gamma et al. (1994, sec. 1.3) , adapted to couplings. Structure is drawn in the boxology notation of hybrid learning and reasoning systems ( van Harmelen and ten Teije, 2019 ; van Bekkum et al., 2021 ) , with the generative model of de Boer et al. (2025) : rectangles are instances ( data such as text, or symbol ), hexagons are models ( model:gen for a language model, model:sem for a rule base), ovals are processes ( infer , transform , generate ) and triangles are actors, here persons. The dashed arrows are ours: they mark a request, from the process that issues it to the process that answers, and so show who triggers whom where the solid arrows show what flows. A reply of the model is text; where it becomes symbols, the receipt is drawn as a transformation. Table 8 in Appendix A lists every symbol; Section 9.2 relates the notation to the catalogue. Sample code is folded into Implementation : each pattern prints its complete program and draws it as a rule graph , generated from the program by a script of the companion folder. Its boxes are the facts, the requests, the receipts and the derived slots; a small circle is one rule, labelled with the line where it starts in the listing (“l. 23” for line 23), with arrows from what it reads to what it derives ( Table 9 ). The boxology shows the roles of a pattern, the rule graph the chain of one program. For the dialogue flow of pattern 5 the graph is a flow diagram of its steps. We add one heading, Evidence , for measured results where they exist, because the consequences of a coupling are empirical in a way the consequences of a class structure are not.
paragraphs.zh: 每个模式按照 Gamma 等人的标题结构进行描述。 (1994，第 1.3 节)，并适配到耦合。 结构采用混合学习与推理系统的框图记法（boxology）绘制（van Harmelen 和 ten Teije，2019；van Bekkum 等，2021），并结合 de Boer 等人的生成模型。 (2025)：矩形是实例（如文本或符号等数据），六边形是模型（model:gen 表示语言模型，model:sem 表示规则库），椭圆是过程（infer、transform、generate），三角形是行动者，此处为人。 虚线箭头是我们添加的：它们标记一个请求，从发出请求的过程指向应答的过程，从而表明谁触发谁，而实线箭头则表明什么在流动。 模型的应答是文本；当它变为符号时，其接收被绘制为一个变换。 附录 A 中的表 8 列出了每个符号；第 9.2 节将该记法与目录关联起来。 示例代码折叠进「实现」部分：每个模式打印其完整程序，并将其绘制为规则图，该图由配套文件夹中的一个脚本从程序生成。 其方框是事实、请求、接收和派生的槽位；小圆圈表示一条规则，以其在程序清单中起始的行标注（第 23 行标注为「l. 23」），箭头从它读取的内容指向它推导出的内容（表 9）。 框图展示一个模式的角色，规则图展示单个程序的链条。 对于模式 5 的对话流，该图是其步骤的流程图。 我们增加一个标题「证据」，用于记录已有的实测结果，因为耦合的后果在经验性上不同于类结构所带来的后果。

paragraphs.en: Let the model read what rules cannot (free text, documents, answers in a conversation) and turn it into proposed facts; a rule decides whether each proposal becomes a fact.
paragraphs.zh: 让模型读取规则无法读取的内容（自由文本、文档、对话中的回答），并将其转化为候选事实；由规则决定每条候选事实是否成为事实。

paragraphs.en: Extraction, classification as a predicate, perception, learned predicate, judge.
paragraphs.zh: 提取、作为谓词的分类、感知、学习到的谓词、判断者。

paragraphs.en: An assignment review must know whether a contract names a signatory with authority, whether a consent form is signed and which party a letter addresses. Rules can decide what follows from these facts, but they cannot read the documents. A model can read them, but it also reports things the document does not say, and a fluent wrong reading looks like a right one. The pattern lets the model read and keeps the decision about what counts with the rules: the model reports each statement with a verbatim quote, the host measures whether the quote occurs, and a rule accepts a statement only if the quote was found and the kind of document can make such a statement.
paragraphs.zh: 一项转让审查必须知道合同是否指定了有权限的签署人、同意书是否已签署、以及信函是写给哪一方的。 规则可以决定从这些事实能得出什么结论，但规则无法阅读文件。 模型可以阅读文件，但它也会报告文件中并没有说的内容，而且一个流畅但错误的读起来就像正确的。 该模式让模型负责阅读，而把「什么算数」的判定留给规则：模型对每条陈述附上逐字引用进行报告，宿主测量该引用是否出现，只有当引用被找到且该类文件可能作出此类陈述时，规则才接受该陈述。

sents.zh: 该模式让模型负责阅读，而把「什么算数」的判定留给规则：模型对每条陈述附上逐字引用进行报告，宿主测量该引用是否出现，只有当引用被找到且该类文件可能作出此类陈述时，规则才接受该陈述。

paragraphs.en: the inputs are unstructured (text, speech, images) but the decision over them is known and can be written as rules;
paragraphs.zh: 输入是非结构化的（文本、语音、图像），但对其的决策是已知的，并且可以写成规则；

paragraphs.en: a reading can be checked by something measurable: a quote that occurs, a value from a closed list, a hash of the source;
paragraphs.zh: 读数可以通过某种可测量的东西来校验：一个出现的引文、一个来自封闭列表的值、源文件的哈希值；

paragraphs.en: the same reading is needed by several rules, so it should exist once as a fact with a provenance.
paragraphs.zh: 多个规则需要同一读取结果，因此它应当以带有来源（provenance）的事实形式只存在一份。

paragraphs.en: Do not use it when the decision itself is what is unknown (then see Division by Competence, Section 4.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 当决策本身未知时，请勿使用该方法（此时请参阅「按能力划分」，第 4.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: Model : reads one input and answers one question about it in a fixed format. Host : calls the model, measures what can be measured (format, quote occurrence), stores the answer as a receipt. Rules : request the reading, accept or reject each proposed fact with a reason. Source : the document or utterance, identified by hash.
paragraphs.zh: 模型：读取一份输入，并以固定格式回答关于它的一个问题。 主持者：调用模型，测量可测量的内容（格式、引文出现情况），并将答案作为凭据存储。 规则：请求读取，并以理由接受或拒绝每个提出的事实。 来源：文档或话语，通过哈希值标识。

sents.en: Model : reads one input and answers one question about it in a fixed format.
sents.zh: 模型：读取一份输入，并以固定格式回答关于它的一个问题。

sents.en: Host : calls the model, measures what can be measured (format, quote occurrence), stores the answer as a receipt.
sents.zh: 主持者：调用模型，测量可测量的内容（格式、引文出现情况），并将答案作为凭据存储。

sents.en: Rules : request the reading, accept or reject each proposed fact with a reason.
sents.zh: 规则：请求读取，并以理由接受或拒绝每个提出的事实。

sents.en: Source : the document or utterance, identified by hash.
sents.zh: 来源：文档或话语，通过哈希值标识。

paragraphs.en: A rule fires an external request for a document that is pending; the host returns a receipt with the model’s answer and its measurements; an acceptance rule turns admissible statements into facts; rejected statements keep their reason. A later revocation of the source withdraws what rested on it.
paragraphs.zh: 规则针对处于待定状态的文档发起外部请求；宿主返回包含模型答案及其度量值的回执；接受规则将可采纳的陈述转化为事实；被拒绝的陈述则保留其被拒原因。 事后对来源的撤销会连带撤回建立在其之上的内容。

paragraphs.en: Each fact has a provenance (source, model, prompt version, date) and a reason for acceptance. An answer that cannot be grounded stays a rejected statement with its reason. A model’s unknown leaves the criterion open. The cost is one call per input and question; a plausible but wrong value that passes every measurable check slips through this pattern and needs a second reader, a person or a cross-check.
paragraphs.zh: 每条事实都有其来源信息（来源、模型、提示词版本、日期）以及被接受的理由。 无法落地的答案会保留为被否决的陈述，并附有其理由。 模型的“未知”会让该判定标准保持开放。 其代价是每个输入和每个问题一次调用；一个貌似合理但错误的值若通过了所有可度量的检查，就会逃过这一模式，因此需要第二位审阅者，即一个人或一次交叉核对。

paragraphs.en: Ask for one thing per call: a value from a fixed list, or a statement with its quote. The request names the source text as groundIn , which the model does not see; the host then records for every row of the answer whether its quote occurs verbatim in that text ( quoteFound ). The program is complete: it declares its world and the slot it negates, states what a contract may say, gives one contract and the prompt, and then the steps every pattern has: the request, the rule that reads the receipt (row ?I is one statement about document ?D ), the rules that accept or reject, and the rule for a failed call.
paragraphs.zh: 每次调用只请求一件事：要么是固定列表中的一个值，要么是一条陈述及其引用原文。 请求将源文本命名为 groundIn，模型看不到该文本；主机随后对答案的每一行记录其引用原文是否逐字出现在该文本中（quoteFound）。 该程序是完整的：它声明了自己的世界和所否定的槽位，说明了合同可以写什么，给出了一份合同和提示词，然后是每个模式都有的步骤：请求、读取回执的规则（第 ?I 行是关于文档 ?D 的一条陈述）、接受或拒绝的规则，以及调用失败时的规则。

A confidence reported by the model is recorded as a number and never read as truth. Where the serving stack supports it, decode every reply under a JSON schema derived from the closed set of allowed values.

paragraphs.en: Assignment review with quote-checked extraction; campervan search (one classification per listing, from a fixed list or unknown ); the judge in dialogue flows (one criterion about one answer); memory claims with quotes in FrameX-Agents; model measurements per object in the Q-calculus example. In the literature: neural perception feeding a reasoner, Kautz’s Neuro | Symbolic ( Kautz, 2022 ) ; learning from data with symbolic output ( van Harmelen and ten Teije, 2019 ; van Bekkum et al., 2021 ) ; knowledge-graph construction by a language model ( Pan et al., 2024 ) .

paragraphs.en: The judge of Rules Steer the Model ( Section 4.2 ) is a sensor for one answer. Critique and Repair ( Section 4.3 ) handles the replies that fail a check. A Sensor whose readings are aggregated by rules over many objects (lists, counts) is where the hybrid’s accuracy advantage was largest.
paragraphs.zh: 规则引导模型（Rules Steer the Model，第 4.2 节）的判定器是针对单个答案的传感器。 批评与修复（Critique and Repair，第 4.3 节）处理未通过检查的回复。 当传感器的读数由规则对多个对象（列表、计数）进行聚合时，混合方法的准确率优势最大。

sents.en: A Sensor whose readings are aggregated by rules over many objects (lists, counts) is where the hybrid’s accuracy advantage was largest.
sents.zh: 当传感器的读数由规则对多个对象（列表、计数）进行聚合时，混合方法的准确率优势最大。

paragraphs.en: Several Readers, One Rule. The same question goes to several models or samples, and rules adjudicate: agreeing readings are accepted, a majority is accepted with its count recorded, and a disagreement becomes unclear and is handed on ( Section 4.4 ); it is never settled by a coin toss. Voting and parallel sampling are published agent and workflow patterns ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Schluntz and Zhang, 2024 ) , and self-consistency beat multi-agent debate at the same number of answers ( Huang et al., 2024 ) . Asking a judge twice with the answers in swapped order and requiring agreement is the same variant applied to position bias ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 多个读取者，一条规则。 同一个问题发给多个模型或多个样本，由规则裁决：一致的读取结果被接受，多数意见被接受并记录其票数，出现分歧则标记为不明确并移交（第 4.4 节）；绝不靠抛硬币来定夺。 投票和并行采样是已发表的智能体与工作流模式（Liu 等，2025；Schluntz 和 Zhang，2024），并且在相同答案数量下，自一致性胜过多智能体辩论（Huang 等，2024）。 以交换答案顺序的方式向裁判提问两次并要求其结论一致，是同一变体用于应对位置偏差的方法（Zheng 等，2023）。

paragraphs.en: In a portfolio of 100 agreements (376 documents), a model alone answered single decisions and four-step chains correctly but produced exact exhaustive lists in 0 of 6 questions at low effort; with the model as sensor and the lists derived by rules, 10 of 10 questions were correct, with a completeness check leaving no silently wrong answer. The extraction was the expensive step: 43.6 cents once against 1.2 cents per question for the model alone. With an 8-billion-parameter open model, the strict quote rule refused correct values and made extraction worse than the model alone (45 % against 60 %): the acceptance rule must fit the reader’s ability to quote.
paragraphs.zh: 在包含100份协议（376份文档）的合同组合中，仅用模型回答单个决策和四步推理链时结果正确，但在低推理强度下6个问题中没有一个能产出完整准确的全量清单；而当模型仅作为传感器、清单由规则推导时，10个问题全部答对，并附带完备性检查，不留任何看似正确实则错误的答案。 抽取是开销最大的环节：一次性花费43.6美分，而仅用模型回答每个问题只需1.2美分。 使用80亿参数的开源模型时，严格的引文规则会拒绝正确的值，使抽取效果比仅用模型更差（45%对60%）：接受规则必须与阅读器正确引用的能力相匹配。

paragraphs.en: Let the model write formal material (rules, decision tables, schemas, tests, dialogue flows, thresholds) and check every draft offline before a person adopts it. The rules never run what the model wrote unchecked.
paragraphs.zh: 让模型撰写正式材料（规则、决策表、模式、测试、对话流程、阈值），并在人工采用之前离线检查每一份草稿。 规则从不未经检查地运行模型所写的内容。

sents.zh: 让模型撰写正式材料（规则、决策表、模式、测试、对话流程、阈值），并在人工采用之前离线检查每一份草稿。

sents.en: The rules never run what the model wrote unchecked.
sents.zh: 规则从不未经检查地运行模型所写的内容。

paragraphs.en: Rule drafting, policy-to-rules, specification-driven authoring, knowledge acquisition with a model.
paragraphs.zh: 规则起草、政策转规则、基于规范的编写，以及借助模型进行知识获取。

paragraphs.en: A policy sentence (“claims above 500 francs need a receipt”) must become a rule, and an amended regulation must become a changed decision table. A model drafts the rule in seconds, and the expensive part is checking it. The pattern moves the cost to a check that is complete for the faults that matter: the draft must parse, may only use allowed heads, and must pass the regression cases and expectations, and the check reports which decisions the draft would change.
paragraphs.zh: 一条政策句子（“超过500法郎的理赔需要收据”）必须变成一条规则，而修订后的法规必须变成一张变更后的决策表。 模型在几秒钟内起草出规则，而昂贵的部分是对它的检查。 该模式把成本转移到一项对重要缺陷而言完备的检查上：草案必须可解析，只能使用允许的表头，并且必须通过回归用例和预期结果，同时该检查会报告草案会改变哪些决策。

sents.zh: 一条政策句子（“超过500法郎的理赔需要收据”）必须变成一条规则，而修订后的法规必须变成一张变更后的决策表。

sents.zh: 模型在几秒钟内起草出规则，而昂贵的部分是对它的检查。

sents.en: The pattern moves the cost to a check that is complete for the faults that matter: the draft must parse, may only use allowed heads, and must pass the regression cases and expectations, and the check reports which decisions the draft would change.
sents.zh: 该模式把成本转移到一项对重要缺陷而言完备的检查上：草案必须可解析，只能使用允许的表头，并且必须通过回归用例和预期结果，同时该检查会报告草案会改变哪些决策。

paragraphs.en: the target notation has a complete check for the faults that matter (syntax, allowed vocabulary, structural anomalies of a decision table, regression cases);
paragraphs.zh: 目标表示法对重要的故障有完整的检查（语法、允许的词汇、决策表的结构异常、回归用例）；

paragraphs.en: regression cases or expectations exist or can be written before the draft;
paragraphs.zh: 草稿完成之前，回归测试用例或预期结果已经存在或可以编写；

paragraphs.en: a person is available to adopt what passes.
paragraphs.zh: 有一个人可以采纳所通过的内容。

paragraphs.en: Where no complete check exists (semantic faults in a large rule base), the draft can only open a review (see Model as Critic, Section 5.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在不存在完整检查的情况下（大型规则库中的语义错误），草稿只能发起一次评审（参见「作为评论者的模型」，第5.2节）。

paragraphs.en: Model : drafts one artefact from a policy text, a change request or failing cases. Checker : parses, restricts heads, evaluates the candidate in a copy of the session against expectations and regression cases. Rules : request the check and derive adoptable , or a failure with the checker’s message that drives the repair. Expert : adopts, edits or refuses.
paragraphs.zh: Model：根据策略文本、变更请求或失败用例起草一份产物。 Checker：进行解析、限制头部，在会话副本中根据预期结果和回归用例评估候选产物。 Rules：请求检查并推导出可采纳的结果，或携带 Checker 的消息给出失败，该消息用于驱动修复。 Expert：采纳、编辑或拒绝。

sents.en: Model : drafts one artefact from a policy text, a change request or failing cases.
sents.zh: Model：根据策略文本、变更请求或失败用例起草一份产物。

sents.en: Checker : parses, restricts heads, evaluates the candidate in a copy of the session against expectations and regression cases.
sents.zh: Checker：进行解析、限制头部，在会话副本中根据预期结果和回归用例评估候选产物。

sents.en: Rules : request the check and derive adoptable , or a failure with the checker’s message that drives the repair.
sents.zh: Rules：请求检查并推导出可采纳的结果，或携带 Checker 的消息给出失败，该消息用于驱动修复。

sents.en: Expert : adopts, edits or refuses.
sents.zh: Expert：采纳、编辑或拒绝。

paragraphs.en: The model’s draft is stored as a receipt; a rule requests its check; the checker’s receipt states regressions and changed decisions; a rule derives either a recommendation for the expert or a precise repair message for the model ( Section 4.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 该模型的草稿被存储为回执；一条规则请求对它进行检查；检查器的回执说明回归和已更改的决策；一条规则据此推导出面向专家的建议，或面向模型的精确修复信息（第 4.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Writing becomes cheap and checking becomes the bottleneck; the quality of the engine’s error messages becomes a design parameter. A draft outside the target language is refused at its first cell or token. What the organisation keeps is the adopted artefact, and the model can be exchanged. The pattern does not detect a draft that is well-formed, passes every case and is still wrong where no case covers it.
paragraphs.zh: 写作变得廉价，检查成为瓶颈；引擎错误信息的质量成为一项设计参数。 目标语言之外的草稿会在其第一个单元格或词元处被拒绝。 组织保留的是被采纳的成品，而模型是可以替换的。 该模式无法检测出格式良好、通过所有用例、却在没有用例覆盖之处仍然错误的草稿。

paragraphs.en: Give the model a template to fill (a rule skeleton, the cell language of a decision table). Check in a copy of the session, and let a person adopt. Phrase engine messages for a reader who repairs: “separate the slots of a frame with ‘;’, not ‘,”’ led to more repairs than “expected ‘;’ ”.
paragraphs.zh: 给模型一个待填写的模板（规则骨架、决策表的单元格语言）。 在会话副本中进行检入，并让人来采纳。 面向负责修复的读者来表述引擎消息：与「预期为 ';'」相比，「请用 ';' 而不是 ',' 来分隔框架的槽位」带来了更多修复。

paragraphs.en: The first request calls the model, the second the checker _checkCandidate . The operator fixes in an adapter file what the checker compares against: the vocabulary file, the hidden cases ( expect true: c3:NeedsReceipt. ) and the only head a draft may have. Its receipt carries status ( checked ; rejected before evaluation, for example for a syntax error or a head outside the allowed set; or error ), and after evaluation regressions (a case that passed before fails now), failedAfter (cases failing after) and one line of feedback . The second half of the program is the repair of Critique and Repair:

paragraphs.en: Rule drafting from one policy sentence with six hidden cases; decision-table drafts and change requests in the DMN round trip, checked against every case and reviewed; the EU Regulation 261/2004 case, where a draft outside the cell language was refused and a change request fixed six of six failing cases, broke none and passed review; mapping suggestions between vocabularies kept as recorded proposals. In the literature: domain-model acquisition with experts in LLM-Modulo ( Kambhampati et al., 2024 ) ; action-schema generation ( Rani et al., 2026 ) ; the engineered model of an actor (pattern 1c) of van Bekkum et al. (2021) , with the model in the engineer’s role.
paragraphs.zh: 从一条包含六个隐藏案例的策略语句起草规则；在 DMN 往返过程中生成决策表草案和变更请求，并对照每个案例进行检查与评审；以欧盟第 261/2004 号条例案例为例，单元格语言之外的草案被拒绝，一个变更请求修复了全部六个失败案例，未破坏任何案例并通过评审；词表之间的映射建议保留为已记录的提案。 文献中：LLM-Modulo 中与专家协作进行领域模型获取（Kambhampati et al., 2024）；动作模式生成（Rani et al., 2026）；van Bekkum 等人提出的行动者（模式 1c）的工程化模型 （2021），其中模型扮演工程师的角色。

paragraphs.en: Critique and Repair ( Section 4.3 ) closes the loop with the checker’s message. Division by Competence ( Section 4.4 ) supplies drafts from recurring model decisions. Model as Critic ( Section 5.2 ) applies where the check is incomplete.

paragraphs.en: In five live runs, a model drafted a rule from one policy sentence; every run ended with a rule that passed all six hidden cases, three at the first attempt, two after one repair of the same syntax slip. From the same faulty drafts, a repair succeeded at the first request in 5 of 10 runs with the message “expected ‘;’ ” and in 10 of 10 with a message naming the fix. Across 36 drafts for 12 policies, messages that name the fix raised repairs within two attempts from 8 of 15 to 14 of 15. In a checking study, static checks over rules found every seeded structural fault at every size at no model cost, while model reviews of code and prompts found an unreachable rule in only 2 or 3 of 10 artefacts at 64 rules.
paragraphs.zh: 在五次实际运行中，一个模型从一条政策句子起草了规则；每次运行最终得到的规则都通过了全部六个隐藏用例，其中三次首次即通过，两次在修复同一处语法错误后通过。 对于同样的错误草稿，附带「缺少 ';'」提示的修复信息在 10 次运行中有 5 次首次请求即修复成功，而明确指出修复方法的信息则在 10 次运行中全部首次修复成功。 在针对 12 项政策共 36 份草稿的测试中，明确指出修复方法的信息将在两次尝试内修复成功的比例从 15 份中的 8 份提高到 15 份中的 14 份。 在一项检查研究中，对规则进行静态检查能在任何规模下发现所有植入的结构性错误，且不产生模型成本；而模型对代码与提示词的审查在规则数达到 64 条时，仅在 10 个产物中的 2 到 3 个里发现不可达的规则。

paragraphs.en: Put the model between a person and the rules, in both directions: the person’s words into a request the rules can answer, and the rules’ answer and proof into words for that person.
paragraphs.zh: 把模型置于人与规则之间，双向进行：将人的话语转化为规则能够回答的请求，并将规则的答案与证明转化为面向该人的话语。

paragraphs.en: Natural-language interface, verbalisation, explanation, the model calls the rules as a tool.
paragraphs.zh: 自然语言接口、言语化、解释，模型将规则作为工具来调用。

paragraphs.en: A clerk asks “can we pay this invoice?” and expects an answer in words, with the reason. The rules hold the answer and its proof but speak in queries and proof trees. The model speaks the clerk’s language but should not decide. The pattern gives the model the conversation and the rules the decision: the model calls the rules as a tool, receives the verdict, the decisive quotes and the missing evidence, and phrases them; the host checks that the reply uses the rules’ decision word.
paragraphs.zh: 一名职员问“我们能支付这张发票吗？”，期望得到一个用文字表达、并附带理由的回答。 规则持有答案及其证明，但以查询和证明树的语言表述。 模型说的是职员的语言，但不应做决定。 该模式让模型负责对话，让规则负责决定：模型把规则作为工具调用，接收判定结果、关键引文和缺失的证据，并将其表述出来；宿主检查回复是否使用了规则的判定用语。

sents.en: A clerk asks “can we pay this invoice?” and expects an answer in words, with the reason.
sents.zh: 一名职员问“我们能支付这张发票吗？”，期望得到一个用文字表达、并附带理由的回答。

sents.en: The rules hold the answer and its proof but speak in queries and proof trees.
sents.zh: 规则持有答案及其证明，但以查询和证明树的语言表述。

sents.zh: 模型说的是职员的语言，但不应做决定。

paragraphs.en: Use it when people ask in their own words, when answers must come with reasons a non-expert can read, or when a model-based assistant needs a verified source of decisions. Prefer fixed templates over a model where the audience and the wording are known (sentences generated from a decision table need no model).
paragraphs.zh: 当人们用自己的话提问、答案必须附带非专业人士能读懂的理由，或基于模型的助手需要一个经验证的决策来源时，可以使用它。 在受众和措辞已知的情况下，应优先使用固定模板而非模型（从决策表生成的句子无需模型）。

sents.zh: 在受众和措辞已知的情况下，应优先使用固定模板而非模型（从决策表生成的句子无需模型）。

paragraphs.en: Person ; Model (translates); Rules (answer, prove, name what is missing: query , explain , why_not , preview , evidence_needs ); Host (checks the reply against the answer).
paragraphs.zh:
Person ; Model (translates); Rules (answer, prove, name what is missing: query , explain , why_not , preview , evidence_needs ); Host (依据答案检查回复)。

Person ；模型（进行翻译）；规则（回答、证明、指出缺失内容：query 、explain 、why_not 、preview 、evidence_needs ）；主持方（依据答案检查回复）。

paragraphs.en: The model turns the question into a call of a read-only operation from a closed set, or, where free queries are admitted, into a candidate query that the rules validate like any draft ( Section 3.2 ) before it runs; the rules answer with a proof; the model phrases the answer; a check binds the phrasing to the answer (decision word, cited proof nodes). In the other direction the rules can be offered read-only to any model client as a server.
paragraphs.zh: 模型把问题转化为对一个封闭集合中只读操作的调用，或者，在允许自由查询的情况下，转化为一个候选查询，该查询在运行前由规则像对待任何草稿一样进行校验（第 3.2 节）；规则以一个证明作答；模型对答案进行表述；一项检查将表述与答案绑定（决策词、被引用的证明节点）。 在另一个方向上，规则可以作为服务器以只读方式提供给任何模型客户端。

sents.en: The model turns the question into a call of a read-only operation from a closed set, or, where free queries are admitted, into a candidate query that the rules validate like any draft ( Section 3.2 ) before it runs; the rules answer with a proof; the model phrases the answer; a check binds the phrasing to the answer (decision word, cited proof nodes).
sents.zh: 模型把问题转化为对一个封闭集合中只读操作的调用，或者，在允许自由查询的情况下，转化为一个候选查询，该查询在运行前由规则像对待任何草稿一样进行校验（第 3.2 节）；规则以一个证明作答；模型对答案进行表述；一项检查将表述与答案绑定（决策词、被引用的证明节点）。

sents.en: In the other direction the rules can be offered read-only to any model client as a server.
sents.zh: 在另一个方向上，规则可以作为服务器以只读方式提供给任何模型客户端。

paragraphs.en: The person gets an answer in words with a proof behind it. A mistranslated question gives a correct answer to the wrong question, so a back-translation shown to the person is the main safeguard. Prose that adds facts the proof lacks must be rejected, which requires the phrasing to cite the proof. The two forms of request differ in what can be checked. A call of a closed operation set keeps invariant 1 without qualification and lets a rule refuse a request with a reason that names the field. A free query is more expressive, but a check can only establish its form, its vocabulary and that it is read-only; it inherits the consequences of Model as Author, and a query that validates can still ask the wrong question.
paragraphs.zh: 该人员得到一个带有证明作为依据的文字答案。 被误译的问题会为错误的问题给出正确的答案，因此向该人员展示回译是主要的保障措施。 在证明之外添加事实的散文式内容必须被拒绝，这就要求其措辞引用该证明。 这两种请求形式在可检查的内容上有所不同。 对封闭操作集的调用无需附加限定即可保持不变式 1，并允许规则以指明字段的方式给出理由来拒绝请求。 自由查询更具表达力，但检查只能确立其形式、其词汇表及其只读属性；它继承了「模型即作者」的后果，且通过校验的查询仍可能问错问题。

paragraphs.en: Prefer a closed set of read-only operations whose arguments are identifiers; the host builds the executable query from the call. Admit a free query only through validate (syntax, allowed classes and slots, no assertions) and record it as a candidate with its receipt. Keep the model’s view small: the verdict, the decisive quotes and the missing evidence, without the documents. Offer the rules as read-only tools with a hash of the files that answered. Bind every sentence of an explanation to a proof node, or use templates.
paragraphs.zh: 优先使用一组封闭的只读操作，其参数为标识符；由宿主根据调用构建可执行的查询。 仅通过校验（语法、允许的类与槽位、不含断言）接受自由查询，并将其连同回执记录为候选。 保持模型可见的内容精简：只包含裁决、决定性的引文和缺失的证据，不包含文档本身。 将规则作为只读工具提供，并附带应答所用文件的哈希值。 将解释中的每个句子绑定到证明节点，或改用模板。

paragraphs.en: In rules, the model’s first call turns the question into a request, the request runs only when every field names a member of a closed list, a refusal names the field, and the rules derive the decision. The second call names the decision word as mustSay , which the model does not see; the host records whether the reply contains it ( saysDecision ), and only such a reply is accepted. The test is a substring test that ignores case: “not admitted” contains “admitted”. Where one decision word contains another, ask for the decision word in a field of its own as well and compare it exactly. The program answers admission questions; the operations requirements and missing are recognised and refused with a reason:
paragraphs.zh: 在规则中，模型的第一次调用把问题转化为一个请求，只有当每个字段都填入封闭列表中的成员时请求才会运行，拒绝时会指明字段，而决策由规则推导得出。 第二次调用把决策词指定为 mustSay，模型看不到它；宿主程序记录回复是否包含该词（saysDecision），并且只有这样的回复才会被接受。 该测试是忽略大小写的子字符串测试：“not admitted” 包含 “admitted”。 当一个决策词包含另一个决策词时，应要求在单独的字段中填入该决策词，并进行精确比较。 该程序回答录取问题；操作 requirements 和 missing 会被识别并以理由拒绝：

paragraphs.en: With translator.fx ( Appendix B ) the program declares the closed list of each answer field and keeps its decision rules. The library reads the fields, refuses a request with the name of the field that lies outside its list, and phrases the decision under mustSay . Decision rules read only valid fields ( tr#valid ). paragraphs.en: Read-Back Check. An independent reader that sees only the written reply reads its facts back, and rules compare them with the facts the reply was meant to state: the decision, the amounts, the dates. It is the translator’s check applied to the output side, and it catches a changed value that a decision word alone does not. The reader must differ from the writer (another model or another prompt), or it repeats the writer’s misreading. Reported in several Hack Apertus submissions (Sturmglocke, Lightpath, SONA with entailment in both directions); not built in FrameX. In one of them, a 70B second reader cut instructions with a changed meaning from 4.6 % to 0.2 % of 2,078 (result file committed in the submission).
paragraphs.zh: 回读校验。 由一名只看到书面回复的独立读者将其事实回读出来，再用规则将这些事实与回复本应陈述的事实进行比对：决定、金额、日期。 它是把译者式的检查应用到输出侧，能够捕捉到仅凭决定措辞发现不了的数值被篡改的情况。 读者必须与写者不同（另一个模型或另一个提示词），否则它会重复写者的误读。 在多个 Hack Apertus 提交作品中有报告（Sturmglocke、Lightpath、采用双向蕴含的 SONA）；FrameX 中未内置。 在其中一个提交中，第二读者采用 70B 模型，将含义被篡改的指令从 2,078 条中的 4.6% 降到 0.2%（结果文件已在提交中提交）。

paragraphs.en: On a clean five-document case, a model alone answered the assignment-review question correctly in 12 of 12 runs at lower cost and time than the hybrid (0.28 against 0.72 cents per case). On easy cases the translator earns its cost through the proof, the stated missing evidence and the fixed decision word.
paragraphs.zh: 在一个干净的五份文档案例中，仅靠模型就能以低于混合方案的成本和时间，在12次运行中12次正确回答任务审核问题（每案例0.28美分对0.72美分）。 在简单案例中，翻译智能体通过证明、所声明的缺失证据和固定的决策词来体现其成本价值。

paragraphs.en: Let the model choose and phrase, but never state content: it returns identifiers of passages that the host numbered, and words around values it never sees. Every passage and every value that reaches a person comes from facts, word for word.
paragraphs.zh: 让模型自行选择和措辞，但绝不陈述内容：它返回的是宿主编了号的段落的标识符，以及它从未见过的值周围的词。 每一段到达人的文字和每一个值，都逐字逐句地来自事实。

sents.en: Every passage and every value that reaches a person comes from facts, word for word.
sents.zh: 每一段到达人的文字和每一个值，都逐字逐句地来自事实。

paragraphs.en: Model points, code speaks; model phrases, code fills; extractive answer by identifier; slot filling; template generation with a model.
paragraphs.zh: 模型出要点，代码来执行；模型出措辞，代码来填充；按标识符抽取答案；槽位填充；用模型进行模板生成。

paragraphs.en: An applicant asks which documents the Master in Business Innovation requires and what the application costs. The answer must quote the regulation exactly and state the fee exactly. A model that writes the answer can paraphrase a requirement into a different one or round a fee, and a check afterwards (a quote that must occur, a decision word that must appear) catches only what it looks for. The pattern moves the check before the writing: the model sees the passages under identifiers and answers with identifiers, and it phrases a sentence around a gap that the rules fill. A requirement the model invents has no identifier, and a fee it never saw it cannot change.
paragraphs.zh: 申请人询问商业创新硕士项目需要哪些文件以及申请费用是多少。 答案必须准确引用规章原文并准确说明费用。 撰写答案的模型可能把某项要求改写成另一项，或对费用进行取整，而事后的检查（必须出现的引文、必须出现的决定用词）只能查出它所关注的内容。 该模式把检查提前到撰写之前：模型在标识符下查看相关段落并以标识符作答，围绕一个由规则填补的空位来组织句子。 模型虚构的要求没有标识符，而它从未见过的费用它也无法改动。

paragraphs.en: the content of an answer exists as facts or source text (regulations, a catalogue, computed amounts, dates) and only its selection or wording needs a model;
paragraphs.zh: 答案的内容以事实或源文本（法规、目录、计算出的金额、日期）的形式存在，只有其选择或措辞需要模型；

paragraphs.en: a wrong word in the content is costly, so a reply must be correct by construction rather than by check;
paragraphs.zh: 内容中一个错误的词代价高昂，因此回复必须在构造时就保证正确，而不是靠事后检查来保证正确；

paragraphs.en: the source can be split into passages that a person reads on their own.
paragraphs.zh: 来源可以被拆分为多个段落，供个人自行阅读。

paragraphs.en: Do not use it when the answer must combine or summarise what no single passage says; then use Model as Translator ( Section 3.3 ) with its check of the reply.
paragraphs.zh: 当答案必须综合或总结没有任何单一文本段能单独涵盖的内容时，请勿使用它；此时应使用「模型作为翻译器」（Model as Translator，第3.3节）及其对回复的核查。

paragraphs.en: Host : splits the source into passages and numbers them, calls the model, stores the reply as a receipt. Model : chooses identifiers from the list it was given, and phrases words around a gap. Rules : request the selection and the phrasing, accept an identifier only if it names a passage of the source, and write the answer from the passages and the values. Person : reads passages and values as they stand in the source.
paragraphs.zh: 主控：把原文拆分成段落并编号，调用模型，把回复存储为回执。 模型：从给定的列表中选择标识符，并围绕一个空缺措辞。 规则：要求提供选择和措辞，只有当标识符指向原文的某个段落时才接受它，并根据段落和数值写出答案。 人员：按照原文的本来面貌阅读段落和数值。

sents.zh: 主控：把原文拆分成段落并编号，调用模型，把回复存储为回执。

sents.en: Model : chooses identifiers from the list it was given, and phrases words around a gap.
sents.zh: 模型：从给定的列表中选择标识符，并围绕一个空缺措辞。

sents.en: Rules : request the selection and the phrasing, accept an identifier only if it names a passage of the source, and write the answer from the passages and the values.
sents.zh: 规则：要求提供选择和措辞，只有当标识符指向原文的某个段落时才接受它，并根据段落和数值写出答案。

sents.en: Person : reads passages and values as they stand in the source.
sents.zh: 人员：按照原文的本来面貌阅读段落和数值。

paragraphs.en: A rule requests a selection for a question with the numbered passages; the receipt holds identifiers; a rule shows the passage of each identifier that belongs to the source and refuses any other with its reason. A second request asks for words before and after a value without the value; a rule inserts the value between them, unless the words state a number of their own.
paragraphs.zh: 规则请求针对某个问题进行选择，并附带编号的段落；回执保存标识符；规则展示每个属于来源的标识符所对应的段落，并拒绝任何其他段落同时说明其理由。 第二个请求要求提供某个值前后的词语但不包含该值；规则将该值插入到这些词语之间，除非这些词语本身指明了一个数字。

sents.zh: 第二个请求要求提供某个值前后的词语但不包含该值；规则将该值插入到这些词语之间，除非这些词语本身指明了一个数字。

paragraphs.en: No sentence of the model reaches the person as content: an invented passage has no identifier and is refused, a fee is never retyped. What the model can still get wrong is the choice: a passage that does not answer the question, or one that is missing. That is a fault of relevance, not of truth, and a person sees it in the source’s own words. Answers are as fluent as the source; text that combines several passages is out of reach. The cost is one call per selection and per phrasing.
paragraphs.zh: 模型的任何句子都不会作为内容送达 person：一段编造的文本没有标识符而被拒绝，费用也从不被重新输入。 模型仍然可能出错的是选择：所选段落没有回答问题，或者该段落缺失。 这是相关性方面的错误，而非真实性方面的错误，而且 person 能用来源本身的话看出来。 答案与来源一样流畅；将多个段落组合起来的文本则无法做到。 代价是每次选择和每次措辞都需要一次调用。

paragraphs.en: In FrameX, the program above; decision-table rows become sentences from templates without any model, the limit case of this pattern. In the submissions to the Hack Apertus hackathon (October 2026), as described in the jury assessments, models chose passage or line identifiers that the application then quoted (QuietLetter, Beneficia, Comfort, StimmFolgen, Fedlex, ClearDesk, a meditation retrieval system) or wrote with placeholders that code filled with numbers and terms (Apertus QA, Bon·Appétit, Sturmglocke, Velum). In the literature: template-based generation, in which the content is fixed before the text is planned ( Reiter and Dale, 2000 ) ; guardrails that restrict a reply to retrieved passages ( Rebedea et al., 2023 ) . In these the selection is checked afterwards or the template is written by hand; here the model fills neither content nor value.
paragraphs.zh: 在 FrameX（即上文程序）中，决策表的行经由模板变成句子，无需任何模型，这是该模式的极限情形。 在 Hack Apertus 黑客马拉松（2026年10月）的参赛作品中，正如评审意见所述，模型选择段落或行标识符，由应用程序随后加以引用（QuietLetter、Beneficia、Comfort、StimmFolgen、Fedlex、ClearDesk、一个冥想检索系统），或以占位符书写，由代码填入数字与术语（Apertus QA、Bon·Appétit、Sturmglocke、Velum）。 在文献中：基于模板的生成，其中内容在文本规划之前即已固定（ Reiter and Dale, 2000 ）；将回复限制在检索到的段落之内的护栏（ Rebedea et al., 2023 ）。 在这些方案中，选择是事后检查的，或模板是手工编写的；而在这里，模型既不填充内容也不填充取值。

paragraphs.en: Model as Sensor ( Section 3.1 ) reads a source and checks quotes afterwards; this pattern makes the quote the only possible answer. Model as Translator ( Section 3.3 ) checks a written reply for the decision word; here the reply cannot contain the decision. Deriving the options first under Model Proposes, Rules Dispose ( Section 4.1 ) is the same move for actions.
paragraphs.zh: 模型作为传感器（第 3.1 节）读取一个来源并事后核对引用；这一模式使该引用成为唯一可能的答案。 模型作为翻译器（第 3.3 节）检查书面回复中是否含有决策词；在这里回复无法包含决策。 在模型提议、规则处置（第 4.1 节）下先推导出选项，对动作而言也是同样的做法。

paragraphs.en: The program is checked against recorded receipts only; FrameX has no measurement of its own. Figures from the hackathon are taken from result files committed in the submissions’ repositories at a named commit; we did not rerun them, and figures that appear only in a README, report or pitch are left out. In an alert generator for civil protection, Apertus v1.5 8B filled code-built slots with a locked official hazard term; the official term and all facts appeared verbatim in 99 % of 120 alerts, against 45 % when the same model translated freely (70B: 98 % against 71 %). There the model still saw the facts and code checked them afterwards, a weaker form of the pattern. In a beneficial-ownership tool, 8B in Q4_K_M on a CPU, citing line identifiers that code verified, got 14 of 14 cases right, with no held-out set. Selection does not close every gap: in court-decision anonymisation, 8B reached a recall of 0.764 against 0.894 for 70B on 537 decisions, and in a statistics question-answering system a rule baseline without any model matched 70B on the main set.
paragraphs.zh: 程序仅根据记录的回执进行检查；FrameX 自身不进行任何测量。 黑客马拉松的数据取自提交仓库中指定提交版本（named commit）的结果文件；我们没有重新运行这些程序，仅出现在 README、报告或演示文稿中的数据被排除在外。 在一个民防警报生成器中，Apertus v1.5 8B 用一个锁定的官方灾害术语填充由代码构建的槽位；在 120 条警报中有 99 % 完整逐字出现了官方术语及全部事实，而同一模型进行自由翻译时仅为 45 %（70B：98 % 对 71 %）。 在该场景中，模型仍能看到事实，并由代码在事后进行核查，这是该模式的一种较弱形式。 在一个受益所有权工具中，8B 以 Q4_K_M 量化在 CPU 上运行，引用了经代码验证的行标识符，在 14 个案例中全部正确，但没有使用留出集。 选择并不能弥补所有差距：在法院判决匿名化任务中，8B 在 537 份判决上的召回率为 0.764，而 70B 为 0.894；在一个统计问答系统中，不使用任何模型的规则基线在主数据集上的表现与 70B 相当。

sents.zh: 程序仅根据记录的回执进行检查；FrameX 自身不进行任何测量。

paragraphs.en: Let the model propose an answer, an action or a choice, and let a rule admit it, refuse it with a reason, or narrow what may be proposed.
paragraphs.zh: 让模型提出一个答案、一个动作或一个选择，然后由规则来接受它、附带理由地拒绝它，或收窄可提出的范围。

paragraphs.en: Guardrail, action gating, policy enforcement point, bounded recommendation.
paragraphs.zh: 护栏、动作门控、策略执行点、有界推荐。

paragraphs.en: An agent proposes to write a file, a model recommends a portfolio weight, an assistant proposes to send a refund. Each proposal may be reasonable, but some must never happen: a write outside the task, a weight change below a materiality threshold, a refund above an authority limit. The pattern keeps the model’s initiative and puts every effect behind a rule that can say no and say why.
paragraphs.zh: 一个智能体提议写入文件，一个模型推荐投资组合权重，一个助手提议发放退款。 每个提议本身可能都合理，但有些绝不能发生：超出任务范围的写入、低于重要性阈值的权重变更、超过权限上限的退款。 该模式保留了模型的主动性，并让每一个效果都受制于一条既能说“不”、又能说明原因的规则。

sents.en: An agent proposes to write a file, a model recommends a portfolio weight, an assistant proposes to send a refund.
sents.zh: 一个智能体提议写入文件，一个模型推荐投资组合权重，一个助手提议发放退款。

sents.en: Each proposal may be reasonable, but some must never happen: a write outside the task, a weight change below a materiality threshold, a refund above an authority limit.
sents.zh: 每个提议本身可能都合理，但有些绝不能发生：超出任务范围的写入、低于重要性阈值的权重变更、超过权限上限的退款。

sents.en: The pattern keeps the model’s initiative and puts every effect behind a rule that can say no and say why.
sents.zh: 该模式保留了模型的主动性，并让每一个效果都受制于一条既能说“不”、又能说明原因的规则。

paragraphs.en: Use it when the model acts (tool calls, messages, transactions), when the space of admissible outcomes is known even if the best one is not, or when a proposal must rest on evidence available at a given time.
paragraphs.zh: 当模型采取行动（工具调用、消息、事务）时使用它，当可接受结果的集合已知但最佳结果未知时使用它，或者当某个提议必须基于在给定时间可获得的证据时使用它。

paragraphs.en: Model (proposes one action or value); Rules (capabilities, preconditions, limits, evidence requirements); Host (executes only what the rules admit); Person (approves what the rules require).
paragraphs.zh: 模型（提出一个动作或价值）；规则（能力、前提条件、限制、证据要求）；宿主（仅执行规则所允许的操作）；人（批准规则所要求的操作）。

paragraphs.en: The proposal arrives as a receipt; rules derive admission or a refusal with its reason; a refusal returns to the model, which replans; the step bound stops a task whose proposals keep being refused. A task is complete when a rule derives it from recorded evidence; a model saying it is done is one more proposal.
paragraphs.zh: 该提案作为回执到达；规则推导出准入或拒绝及其理由；拒绝会返回给智能体，由其重新规划；步骤上限会终止那些提案不断被拒绝的任务。 当规则从已记录的证据中推导出任务完成时，任务即告完成；智能体声称任务完成只是又一个提案。

sents.en: The proposal arrives as a receipt; rules derive admission or a refusal with its reason; a refusal returns to the model, which replans; the step bound stops a task whose proposals keep being refused.
sents.zh: 该提案作为回执到达；规则推导出准入或拒绝及其理由；拒绝会返回给智能体，由其重新规划；步骤上限会终止那些提案不断被拒绝的任务。

sents.en: A task is complete when a rule derives it from recorded evidence; a model saying it is done is one more proposal.
sents.zh: 当规则从已记录的证据中推导出任务完成时，任务即告完成；智能体声称任务完成只是又一个提案。

paragraphs.en: Effects become auditable and bounded; the model may still waste turns on refused proposals. Conflicts between constraints are reported to a person, and no priority order settles them silently. The pattern bounds what can happen; whether an admitted proposal is the best one stays open.
paragraphs.zh: 效果变得可审计且有边界；模型仍可能在被拒绝的提案上浪费轮次。 约束之间的冲突会报告给相关人员，且没有优先级顺序会悄然解决这些冲突。 该模式限定了可能发生的事情的范围；被接纳的提案是否是最佳方案仍然悬而未决。

sents.en: Effects become auditable and bounded; the model may still waste turns on refused proposals.
sents.zh: 效果变得可审计且有边界；模型仍可能在被拒绝的提案上浪费轮次。

sents.en: Conflicts between constraints are reported to a person, and no priority order settles them silently.
sents.zh: 约束之间的冲突会报告给相关人员，且没有优先级顺序会悄然解决这些冲突。

sents.en: The pattern bounds what can happen; whether an admitted proposal is the best one stays open.
sents.zh: 该模式限定了可能发生的事情的范围；被接纳的提案是否是最佳方案仍然悬而未决。

paragraphs.en: Derive the options first where they are few (configurations, offers in a legal band) and let the model choose among them; a rule checks that the choice is one of them. Export the closed set of allowed values as the structured-output schema of the call, and still check the receipt.
paragraphs.zh: 先在选项较少的地方（配置项、法律区间内的报价）枚举出候选集，让模型从中选择；再由规则校验所选的是否在其中。 把允许值的封闭集合导出为该次调用的结构化输出模式，并且仍然要核对回执。

sents.en: Derive the options first where they are few (configurations, offers in a legal band) and let the model choose among them; a rule checks that the choice is one of them.
sents.zh: 先在选项较少的地方（配置项、法律区间内的报价）枚举出候选集，让模型从中选择；再由规则校验所选的是否在其中。

sents.en: Export the closed set of allowed values as the structured-output schema of the call, and still check the receipt.
sents.zh: 把允许值的封闭集合导出为该次调用的结构化输出模式，并且仍然要核对回执。

paragraphs.en: Each step is a new request propose(?T, ?N) whose receipt becomes a proposal. A proposal is admitted only for an action the task grants; any other is refused with a reason. An admitted look-up runs as a query on the rules themselves ( _query ), and the next step carries the outcome of the last one, the refusal or the looked-up result. The task is complete when an admitted finish rests on evidence, and it stops at the step bound otherwise:
paragraphs.zh: 每一步都是一个新请求 propose(?T, ?N)，其回执成为提案。 提案只有针对任务所授予的动作才会被受理；任何其他请求都会被拒绝并给出理由。 被受理的查询会作为对规则本身的查询执行（_query），而下一步会携带上一步的结果，即拒绝或查得的结论。 当一个被受理的 finish 基于证据时，任务即告完成；否则它会在步数上限处停止：

paragraphs.en: FrameX-Agents (one action at a time, admitted against the task’s capabilities, completion from evidence); allocation recommendation with point-in-time evidence and a materiality gate; casework actions that need a native authorisation proof. In the literature: rule-based safeguards around a model ( Washizaki et al., 2020 ; Washizaki et al., 2022 ) ; hard critics in LLM-Modulo ( Kambhampati et al., 2024 ) ; guardrails ( Rebedea et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) ; gates in prompt chains ( Schluntz and Zhang, 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: FrameX-Agents（一次执行一个动作，需依据任务的能力获得准入，从证据中判定完成）；带时点证据与重要性门槛的分配建议；需要原生授权证明的案件处理动作。 在文献中：围绕模型基于规则的保障措施（Washizaki et al., 2020；Washizaki et al., 2022）；LLM-Modulo 中的硬性评判者（Kambhampati et al., 2024）；护栏（Rebedea et al., 2023；Liu et al., 2025）；提示链中的门控（Schluntz and Zhang, 2024）。

paragraphs.en: Critique and Repair ( Section 4.3 ) handles refused proposals. Rules Steer the Model ( Section 4.2 ) decides what the model is asked to propose next.
paragraphs.zh: 批评与修复（第4.3节）处理被拒绝的提案。 规则引导模型（第4.2节）决定接下来要求模型提出什么提案。

sents.en: Critique and Repair ( Section 4.3 ) handles refused proposals.
sents.zh: 批评与修复（第4.3节）处理被拒绝的提案。

sents.en: Rules Steer the Model ( Section 4.2 ) decides what the model is asked to propose next.
sents.zh: 规则引导模型（第4.2节）决定接下来要求模型提出什么提案。

paragraphs.en: Simulator Disposes. A simulation instead of a rule decides about the proposal: the host runs the proposed plan in a simulator, and its receipt (reached, collided, within budget) is what the rules accept or refuse. The simulator is an external tool like any other, so the receipt keeps its version and inputs, and the rules still make the decision. It is close to the preview in a copy of the session of Model as Hypothesis Generator ( Section 5.1 ). Reported in Hack Apertus submissions (Lightpath, Sturmglocke, Rescue Briefings, Forester); not built in FrameX. In one of them, simulated violations were 16.4 % when the model chose the path and 10.5 % when a rule engine did, over three seeds (result file committed in the submission).
paragraphs.zh: 模拟器裁决。 由模拟而非规则来决定提案：宿主在模拟器中运行所提计划，其回执（是否到达、是否碰撞、是否在预算内）才是规则接受或拒绝的依据。 模拟器是与其他工具一样的外部工具，因此回执会保留其版本与输入，决策仍由规则作出。 它接近于「模型作为假设生成器」（第 5.1 节）会话副本中的预览。 见 Hack Apertus 的提交作品（Lightpath、Sturmglocke、Rescue Briefings、Forester）；未在 FrameX 中构建。 在其中一个提交中，模型选择路径时模拟违规率为 16.4%，规则引擎选择路径时为 10.5%，基于三个随机种子（结果文件已随提交一并上传）。

sents.en: Simulator Disposes.
sents.zh: 模拟器裁决。

sents.en: A simulation instead of a rule decides about the proposal: the host runs the proposed plan in a simulator, and its receipt (reached, collided, within budget) is what the rules accept or refuse.
sents.zh: 由模拟而非规则来决定提案：宿主在模拟器中运行所提计划，其回执（是否到达、是否碰撞、是否在预算内）才是规则接受或拒绝的依据。

sents.en: The simulator is an external tool like any other, so the receipt keeps its version and inputs, and the rules still make the decision.
sents.zh: 模拟器是与其他工具一样的外部工具，因此回执会保留其版本与输入，决策仍由规则作出。

sents.en: It is close to the preview in a copy of the session of Model as Hypothesis Generator ( Section 5.1 ).

paragraphs.en: Let rules decide what the model is asked, when, with which context and which tools. The model never decides the next step.
paragraphs.zh: 让规则决定向模型询问什么、何时询问、使用哪些上下文和哪些工具。 模型从不决定下一步。

sents.en: Let rules decide what the model is asked, when, with which context and which tools.
sents.zh: 让规则决定向模型询问什么、何时询问、使用哪些上下文和哪些工具。

sents.en: The model never decides the next step.
sents.zh: 模型从不决定下一步。

paragraphs.en: Dialogue flow, guided conversation, symbolic orchestration, state machine with model leaves, rule-selected context.
paragraphs.zh: 对话流程、引导式对话、符号编排、带模型叶子的状态机、规则选择的上下文。

paragraphs.en: A triage call must ask about emergency signs first, ask one thing at a time, ask again when an answer is unclear, and hand over to a nurse when a sign is present. A model asked to run the whole call from a long prompt skips questions as the protocol grows. The pattern turns the protocol into rules: a flow derives the current step, the model phrases its question, a judge decides whether the answer satisfies the step, and rules decide branching, re-asking, hand-over and the end.
paragraphs.zh: 分诊通话必须先询问急症体征，一次只问一件事，当回答不清楚时再次追问，并在出现体征时转交给护士。 当要求模型用一个长提示词完成整段通话时，随着流程变长，它会跳过问题。 该模式将流程转化为规则：一个流（flow）推导出当前步骤，模型组织问题的措辞，一个裁判（judge）判断回答是否满足该步骤，而规则决定分支、重新追问、转交和结束。

sents.en: A triage call must ask about emergency signs first, ask one thing at a time, ask again when an answer is unclear, and hand over to a nurse when a sign is present.
sents.zh: 分诊通话必须先询问急症体征，一次只问一件事，当回答不清楚时再次追问，并在出现体征时转交给护士。

sents.en: A model asked to run the whole call from a long prompt skips questions as the protocol grows.
sents.zh: 当要求模型用一个长提示词完成整段通话时，随着流程变长，它会跳过问题。

sents.en: The pattern turns the protocol into rules: a flow derives the current step, the model phrases its question, a judge decides whether the answer satisfies the step, and rules decide branching, re-asking, hand-over and the end.
sents.zh: 该模式将流程转化为规则：一个流（flow）推导出当前步骤，模型组织问题的措辞，一个裁判（judge）判断回答是否满足该步骤，而规则决定分支、重新追问、转交和结束。

paragraphs.en: Use it when the process is known (a protocol, an interview, an intake, an agent’s phases), when the number of rules a model would have to apply by itself grows with the case, or when what the model may see must be decided by policy (permissions, point-in-time availability, jurisdiction).
paragraphs.zh: 当流程是已知的（协议、访谈、信息采集、智能体的各个阶段），当模型需要自行应用的规则数量随案例增长，或者当模型可以看到的内容必须由策略决定（权限、时点可用性、司法管辖区）时，使用它。

paragraphs.en: Rules (flow steps, slots, branches, phase, permitted tools, selected sources, missing evidence); Dialogue model (phrases the current question); Judge (one criterion about one answer, a verdict from a fixed set); Person (answers, or takes over).
paragraphs.zh: 规则（流程步骤、槽位、分支、阶段、允许的工具、选定的来源、缺失的证据）；对话模型（对当前问题的短语描述）；评判者（针对一个回答的一条标准，来自固定集合的裁决）；人（回答，或接管）。

paragraphs.en: Each turn: rules derive the step; the dialogue model asks; the person answers; the judge returns answered , not answered or unclear with a reason; rules decide the next step. An unanswered question never decides a branch.
paragraphs.zh: 每一轮：规则推导出步骤；对话模型提问；用户作答；评判方返回「已回答」「未回答」或「不明确」并附理由；规则决定下一步。 未被回答的问题永远不决定分支走向。

sents.en: Each turn: rules derive the step; the dialogue model asks; the person answers; the judge returns answered , not answered or unclear with a reason; rules decide the next step.
sents.zh: 每一轮：规则推导出步骤；对话模型提问；用户作答；评判方返回「已回答」「未回答」或「不明确」并附理由；规则决定下一步。

sents.en: An unanswered question never decides a branch.
sents.zh: 未被回答的问题永远不决定分支走向。

paragraphs.en: The protocol is executed completely regardless of its length; the model’s work per call stays small, so a weaker model suffices. Every turn has a receipt. The cost is one or more calls per turn, and a judge’s verdict that contradicts its own reason is a failure the rules must catch.
paragraphs.zh: 无论协议有多长都会完整执行；模型每次调用的工作量保持很小，因此使用较弱的智能体即可胜任。 每一轮都有回执。 代价是每轮一次或多次调用，而评审者给出与自身理由相矛盾的裁决，则是规则必须捕获的失败情况。

paragraphs.en: Ask one thing per question. Name verdict labels that cannot be read as content ( answered instead of yes ). Let the judge read the earlier answers it needs. Derive the missing evidence for a goal and ask for exactly that. Select only the rules that apply or nearly apply to the case as context.
paragraphs.zh: 每次提问只问一件事。 使用无法被当作内容解读的裁决标签（用 answered 代替 yes）。 让裁判读取它所需要的先前回答。 针对目标推导缺失的证据，并精确地索要该证据。 只选取适用于或近乎适用于该案例的规则作为上下文。

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 draws the flow as a diagram. A flow#Collect step asks flow#ask , lets a judge decide flow#criterion about the answer and records the outcome in the slot named by flow#slot . flow#ifSlot , flow#to and flow#otherwise branch on a slot; flow#maxAttempts bounds the attempts (three by default); a flow#Say step shows a text, and flow#end ends the flow. The library derives which step holds the token ( flow#Active ) and which attempt is due ( flow#askNow ), and it issues two model calls per attempt. advice:flow#Flow[flow#start -> programme] declares the flow and its first step. A rejected attempt ( flow#rejected ) is asked again while attempts remain below the step’s limit ( flow#limit , from flow#maxAttempts ). Four of the library’s rules, shown only to make the chain visible:
paragraphs.zh: 图 7 将该流程绘制为示意图。 一个 flow#Collect 步骤会执行 flow#ask，让判定者根据 flow#criterion 对答案作出判断，并将结果记录到 flow#slot 所命名的槽位中。flow#ifSlot、flow#to 和 flow#otherwise 依据槽位进行分支；flow#maxAttempts 限制尝试次数（默认为三次）；一个 flow#Say 步骤显示一段文本，而 flow#end 结束该流程。 该库会推导出哪个步骤持有令牌（flow#Active）以及当前该进行哪次尝试（flow#askNow），并且在每次尝试中发起两次模型调用。advice:flow#Flow[flow#start -> programme] 声明该流程及其第一个步骤。 一次被拒绝的尝试（flow#rejected）会在尝试次数仍低于该步骤的上限（flow#limit，来自 flow#maxAttempts）时被再次询问。 该库的四条规则，仅用于展示使该链路可见：
