paragraphs.en: With synthetic intake protocols of 4 to 96 questions, the hybrid decided all 770 runs correctly; a model applying the same rules in the conversation fell to 39 of 60 at 64 questions and 31 of 60 at 96, with 45 of its 50 errors unsafe (McNemar p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). Without reasoning, the same model decided 10 of 30 conversations as a pure model and 30 of 30 in the hybrid. On a ladder of six local models, no model up to 70 billion parameters reached the criterion as a pure model, while a 9-billion model sufficed for the hybrid in single decisions. Cost favours neither side: with cached input priced, the two cost about the same at 64 and 96 questions. In a telephone-triage head-to-head on 14 simulated callers, a model alone was first more accurate (274 of 280 against 243 of 280). The hybrid’s errors had one cause, found in its recorded verdicts and reasons and corrected in one place in the judge; afterwards it was right in 278 of 280 runs and in 199 of 200 on unseen callers, level with the model alone within noise, at lower cost per call and with every level traced to recorded verdicts.
paragraphs.zh: 在由 4 至 96 个问题组成的合成接诊流程中，混合方案在全部 770 次运行中均判定正确；而在对话中直接应用相同规则的模型，在 64 个问题时仅正确 39/60，在 96 个问题时仅正确 31/60，其 50 个错误中有 45 个是不安全的（McNemar 检验 p < 0.001 p<0.001）。 在不使用推理的情况下，同一模型作为纯模型时仅对 30 段对话中的 10 段作出判定，而在混合方案中则对 30 段对话中的 30 段全部作出判定。 在由六个本地模型组成的梯度测试中，在 700 亿参数以内没有任何模型作为纯模型能达到标准，而对于混合方案，一个 90 亿参数的模型在单次判定中就已足够。 成本对双方都不偏袒：计入缓存输入的价格后，两者在 64 个问题和 96 个问题时的成本大致相同。 在针对 14 位模拟来电者的电话分诊正面对比中，纯模型起初更为准确（280 次中正确 274 次，对比 280 次中正确 243 次）。 混合方案的错误只有一个原因，该原因在其记录的判定和理由中被发现，并通过在裁判智能体中的一处修改得以纠正；此后它在 280 次运行中正确 278 次，在未见过的来电者上 200 次中正确 199 次，与纯模型在噪声范围内持平，同时每次呼叫成本更低，且每个层级都可追溯到已记录的判定。

sents.en: With synthetic intake protocols of 4 to 96 questions, the hybrid decided all 770 runs correctly; a model applying the same rules in the conversation fell to 39 of 60 at 64 questions and 31 of 60 at 96, with 45 of its 50 errors unsafe (McNemar p < 0.001 p<0.001 ).
sents.zh: 在由 4 至 96 个问题组成的合成接诊流程中，混合方案在全部 770 次运行中均判定正确；而在对话中直接应用相同规则的模型，在 64 个问题时仅正确 39/60，在 96 个问题时仅正确 31/60，其 50 个错误中有 45 个是不安全的（McNemar 检验 p < 0.001 p<0.001）。

sents.en: Without reasoning, the same model decided 10 of 30 conversations as a pure model and 30 of 30 in the hybrid.
sents.zh: 在不使用推理的情况下，同一模型作为纯模型时仅对 30 段对话中的 10 段作出判定，而在混合方案中则对 30 段对话中的 30 段全部作出判定。

sents.en: On a ladder of six local models, no model up to 70 billion parameters reached the criterion as a pure model, while a 9-billion model sufficed for the hybrid in single decisions.
sents.zh: 在由六个本地模型组成的梯度测试中，在 700 亿参数以内没有任何模型作为纯模型能达到标准，而对于混合方案，一个 90 亿参数的模型在单次判定中就已足够。

sents.en: Cost favours neither side: with cached input priced, the two cost about the same at 64 and 96 questions.
sents.zh: 成本对双方都不偏袒：计入缓存输入的价格后，两者在 64 个问题和 96 个问题时的成本大致相同。

sents.en: In a telephone-triage head-to-head on 14 simulated callers, a model alone was first more accurate (274 of 280 against 243 of 280).
sents.zh: 在针对 14 位模拟来电者的电话分诊正面对比中，纯模型起初更为准确（280 次中正确 274 次，对比 280 次中正确 243 次）。

sents.en: The hybrid’s errors had one cause, found in its recorded verdicts and reasons and corrected in one place in the judge; afterwards it was right in 278 of 280 runs and in 199 of 200 on unseen callers, level with the model alone within noise, at lower cost per call and with every level traced to recorded verdicts.
sents.zh: 混合方案的错误只有一个原因，该原因在其记录的判定和理由中被发现，并通过在裁判智能体中的一处修改得以纠正；此后它在 280 次运行中正确 278 次，在未见过的来电者上 200 次中正确 199 次，与纯模型在噪声范围内持平，同时每次呼叫成本更低，且每个层级都可追溯到已记录的判定。

paragraphs.en: When a model’s reply fails a check, classify the failure by rule, state it, and ask again with the problem and the faulty reply in the prompt, a bounded number of times; stop on repetition.
paragraphs.zh: 当模型的回复未通过检查时，按规则对失败进行分类并说明，然后在提示词中附上问题及错误回复再次询问，次数有限；若重复失败则停止。

paragraphs.en: Generate, verify, repair; validated retry; feedback loop with an external critic.
paragraphs.zh: 生成、验证、修复；经验证的重试；带外部评审者的反馈回路。

paragraphs.en: At temperature zero a model gives the same reply to the same input; asking again without changing the input does not help, and a model asked to check itself without external feedback often makes things worse. The rules know what is wrong (a key misspelled, a quote not found, an action not allowed, rows missing) and can say so.
paragraphs.zh: 在温度为零时，模型对相同输入会给出相同的回复；在不改变输入的情况下再次询问并无帮助，而让模型在没有外部反馈的情况下自我检查，往往会使情况变得更糟。 规则知道哪里出了问题（某个键拼写错误、某条引用未找到、某个操作不被允许、缺少若干行），并且能够这样说明。

sents.en: At temperature zero a model gives the same reply to the same input; asking again without changing the input does not help, and a model asked to check itself without external feedback often makes things worse.
sents.zh: 在温度为零时，模型对相同输入会给出相同的回复；在不改变输入的情况下再次询问并无帮助，而让模型在没有外部反馈的情况下自我检查，往往会使情况变得更糟。

sents.en: The rules know what is wrong (a key misspelled, a quote not found, an action not allowed, rows missing) and can say so.
sents.zh: 规则知道哪里出了问题（某个键拼写错误、某条引用未找到、某个操作不被允许、缺少若干行），并且能够这样说明。

paragraphs.en: Use it whenever another pattern checks a reply: format errors, ungrounded statements, refused proposals, incomplete extractions, failed regression cases of a draft.
paragraphs.zh: 每当另一个模式检查回复时都可以使用它：格式错误、无依据的陈述、被拒绝的提案、不完整的提取结果，以及草稿的回归测试用例失败。

paragraphs.en: Validator in the host (measures format and occurrence); Rules (classify, decide, bound); Model ; Person or a stronger model (escalation).
paragraphs.zh: 主机中的验证器（衡量格式与出现情况）；规则（分类、决策、限定边界）；模型；人或更强的模型（升级处理）。

paragraphs.en: The rules classify a failure into one of six kinds and respond per kind:
paragraphs.zh: 规则将故障归为六类之一，并按类别进行响应：

paragraphs.en: Each repair is a new request with its own identity and receipt; both replies stay recorded. The first five kinds are results the rules can tell apart, as invariant 5 requires. The sixth is the class that no check can detect; we list it so that a passed check is never read as protection against it.
paragraphs.zh: 每次修复都是具有自身标识和回执的新请求；两个回复都会被保留记录。 前五种是规则能够区分的结果，正如不变式 5 所要求的那样。 第六种是任何检查都无法检测到的类别；我们列出它，是为了使通过的检查永远不会被解读为对它的防护。

sents.en: Each repair is a new request with its own identity and receipt; both replies stay recorded.
sents.zh: 每次修复都是具有自身标识和回执的新请求；两个回复都会被保留记录。

sents.en: The first five kinds are results the rules can tell apart, as invariant 5 requires.
sents.zh: 前五种是规则能够区分的结果，正如不变式 5 所要求的那样。

sents.en: The sixth is the class that no check can detect; we list it so that a passed check is never read as protection against it.
sents.zh: 第六种是任何检查都无法检测到的类别；我们列出它，是为了使通过的检查永远不会被解读为对它的防护。

paragraphs.en: Repairs succeed when the message names the fix. The bound keeps cost predictable. Silent correction is excluded: mapping “ja” to yes is guessing and is refused; a correction is accepted without a call only when trusted facts entail it, as a derived fact with its own proof.
paragraphs.zh: 当消息明确指出修复方法时，修复才能成功。 该边界使成本可预测。 排除静默更正：将 "ja" 映射为 yes 属于猜测，会被拒绝；只有在可信事实能够必然推出该更正时，才可以在不调用的情况下接受更正，并作为一个拥有自身证明的派生事实。

sents.en: Repairs succeed when the message names the fix.
sents.zh: 当消息明确指出修复方法时，修复才能成功。

sents.en: The bound keeps cost predictable.
sents.zh: 该边界使成本可预测。

sents.en: Silent correction is excluded: mapping “ja” to yes is guessing and is refused; a correction is accepted without a call only when trusted facts entail it, as a derived fact with its own proof.
sents.zh: 排除静默更正：将 "ja" 映射为 yes 属于猜测，会被拒绝；只有在可信事实能够必然推出该更正时，才可以在不调用的情况下接受更正，并作为一个拥有自身证明的派生事实。

paragraphs.en: For a plain model call, the repair is part of the program. The program of Model as Author ( Section 3.2 ) contains it: every failure keeps the checker’s message, and a new request draft(?P, ?M) with the next number hands the model its rule and that message. It stops at maxAttempts , and earlier when the same message comes back twice ( stalled ):
paragraphs.zh: 对于普通的模型调用，修复是程序的一部分。 「模型作为作者」（第 3.2 节）的程序中包含了这一点：每次失败都会保留检查器的消息，并且一个带有下一个编号的新请求 draft(?P, ?M) 会把规则和该消息交给智能体。 它在 maxAttempts 时停止，当相同的消息出现两次（stalled，即停滞）时也会更早停止：

sents.en: For a plain model call, the repair is part of the program.
sents.zh: 对于普通的模型调用，修复是程序的一部分。

sents.en: The program of Model as Author ( Section 3.2 ) contains it: every failure keeps the checker’s message, and a new request draft(?P, ?M) with the next number hands the model its rule and that message.
sents.zh: 「模型作为作者」（第 3.2 节）的程序中包含了这一点：每次失败都会保留检查器的消息，并且一个带有下一个编号的新请求 draft(?P, ?M) 会把规则和该消息交给智能体。

sents.en: It stops at maxAttempts , and earlier when the same message comes back twice ( stalled ):
sents.zh: 它在 maxAttempts 时停止，当相同的消息出现两次（stalled，即停滞）时也会更早停止：

paragraphs.en: In the recorded run the first draft lacked its final full stop and was rejected before evaluation; the repair request carried the message “expected ‘.’ ”, and the second draft passed all cases.
paragraphs.zh: 在录制的运行中，第一份草稿缺少末尾的句号，在评估前被拒绝；修复请求携带消息“expected ‘.’”，第二份草稿通过了所有用例。

paragraphs.en: In a dialogue flow the library does the same for the dialogue model. The host validates each reply of _turn against the agreed format and writes what it found into the receipt; a rule of the library reads a format error and requests _repairTurn , which calls the same model again with the question, the problem and the faulty reply:
paragraphs.zh: 在对话流中，该库对对话模型做同样的事情。 宿主按照约定的格式校验 _turn 的每个回复，并将其发现的问题写入回执；库的一条规则读取到格式错误后请求 _repairTurn，后者用问题、错误说明和有缺陷的回复再次调用同一个模型：

sents.en: In a dialogue flow the library does the same for the dialogue model.
sents.zh: 在对话流中，该库对对话模型做同样的事情。

sents.en: The host validates each reply of _turn against the agreed format and writes what it found into the receipt; a rule of the library reads a format error and requests _repairTurn , which calls the same model again with the question, the problem and the faulty reply:
sents.zh: 宿主按照约定的格式校验 _turn 的每个回复，并将其发现的问题写入回执；库的一条规则读取到格式错误后请求 _repairTurn，后者用问题、错误说明和有缺陷的回复再次调用同一个模型：

paragraphs.en: The receipt that triggers it reads, for example, result("formatError") -> "missing key: answer" . A second broken reply ends the flow with workflow[status -> "interrupted"] and its reason.
paragraphs.zh: 触发它的回执内容例如是 result("formatError") -> "missing key: answer" 。 第二次损坏的回复会以 workflow[status -> "interrupted"] 及其原因结束该流程。

sents.en: The receipt that triggers it reads, for example, result("formatError") -> "missing key: answer" .
sents.zh: 触发它的回执内容例如是 result("formatError") -> "missing key: answer" 。

sents.en: A second broken reply ends the flow with workflow[status -> "interrupted"] and its reason.
sents.zh: 第二次损坏的回复会以 workflow[status -> "interrupted"] 及其原因结束该流程。

paragraphs.en: The repair loop is part of two libraries: author.fx for drafts checked by a tool ( Section 3.2 ) and FrameX’s flow.fx for dialogue turns ( Section 4.2 ). A program that loads one of them gets the bounded repair without writing a rule.
paragraphs.zh: 修复循环属于两个库：author.fx 用于经工具检查的草稿（见 3.2 节），FrameX 的 flow.fx 用于对话轮次（见 4.2 节）。 加载其中一个库的程序无需编写规则即可获得有界修复能力。

sents.en: The repair loop is part of two libraries: author.fx for drafts checked by a tool ( Section 3.2 ) and FrameX’s flow.fx for dialogue turns ( Section 4.2 ).
sents.zh: 修复循环属于两个库：author.fx 用于经工具检查的草稿（见 3.2 节），FrameX 的 flow.fx 用于对话轮次（见 4.2 节）。

sents.en: A program that loads one of them gets the bounded repair without writing a rule.
sents.zh: 加载其中一个库的程序无需编写规则即可获得有界修复能力。

paragraphs.en: Format repair of dialogue turns and judges; refused agent actions and premature finishes with their failed checks; completeness checks that turn a partial extraction into unknown ; the rule-drafting loop with the checker’s message. In the literature: refinement from solver error messages in Logic-LM ( Pan et al., 2023 ) , tool-grounded critique ( Gou et al., 2024 ) , the back-prompt controller of LLM-Modulo ( Kambhampati et al., 2024 ) ; self-feedback without an external check ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) , whose gains Huang et al. (2024) trace to oracle stopping signals.
paragraphs.zh: 对话轮次与裁判的格式修复；智能体被拒绝的动作与过早结束及其未通过的检查项；将部分抽取结果转为“未知”的完整性检查；带检查器消息的规则草拟循环。 在文献中：Logic-LM（Pan et al., 2023）中基于求解器错误消息的精炼，基于工具的批判（Gou et al., 2024），LLM-Modulo 的回提示控制器（Kambhampati et al., 2024）；以及没有外部检查的自反馈（Madaan et al., 2023；Shinn et al., 2023），其收益被 Huang et al. （2024）归因于预言机式的停止信号。

sents.en: Format repair of dialogue turns and judges; refused agent actions and premature finishes with their failed checks; completeness checks that turn a partial extraction into unknown ; the rule-drafting loop with the checker’s message.
sents.zh: 对话轮次与裁判的格式修复；智能体被拒绝的动作与过早结束及其未通过的检查项；将部分抽取结果转为“未知”的完整性检查；带检查器消息的规则草拟循环。

sents.en: In the literature: refinement from solver error messages in Logic-LM ( Pan et al., 2023 ) , tool-grounded critique ( Gou et al., 2024 ) , the back-prompt controller of LLM-Modulo ( Kambhampati et al., 2024 ) ; self-feedback without an external check ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) , whose gains Huang et al.
sents.zh: 在文献中：Logic-LM（Pan et al., 2023）中基于求解器错误消息的精炼，基于工具的批判（Gou et al., 2024），LLM-Modulo 的回提示控制器（Kambhampati et al., 2024）；以及没有外部检查的自反馈（Madaan et al., 2023；Shinn et al., 2023），其收益被 Huang et al.

sents.en: (2024) trace to oracle stopping signals.
sents.zh: （2024）归因于预言机式的停止信号。

paragraphs.en: It completes Model as Sensor, Model as Author and Model Proposes, Rules Dispose. Model as Critic ( Section 5.2 ) is its reverse: there the model criticises the rules.
paragraphs.zh: 它补全了「模型作为传感器」「模型作为作者」以及「模型提议、规则裁决」。 「模型作为批评者」（第 5.2 节）则与之相反：在那里由模型对规则提出批评。

sents.en: It completes Model as Sensor, Model as Author and Model Proposes, Rules Dispose.
sents.zh: 它补全了「模型作为传感器」「模型作为作者」以及「模型提议、规则裁决」。

sents.en: Model as Critic ( Section 5.2 ) is its reverse: there the model criticises the rules.
sents.zh: 「模型作为批评者」（第 5.2 节）则与之相反：在那里由模型对规则提出批评。

paragraphs.en: See Model as Author: naming the fix raised first-request repairs from 5 of 10 to 10 of 10. In the literature, self-correction without an external signal lowered accuracy, and the gains reported for self-refinement rested on oracle stopping signals ( Huang et al., 2024 ) ; back-prompting from a sound validator raised executable plans from about 12 % to 82 % in one planning domain ( Kambhampati et al., 2024 ) . The rules play the part of that signal and of that validator.
paragraphs.zh: 参见「以模型为作者」：对修复进行命名，使首次请求修复率从 10 例中的 5 例提升到 10 例中的 10 例。 文献表明，在没有外部信号的情况下进行自我纠正会降低准确率，而自我改进所报告的收益依赖于理想停机信号（Huang 等，2024）；在某一规划领域中，由可靠的验证器进行反向提示，将可执行计划的比例从约 12% 提升到 82%（Kambhampati 等，2024）。 这些规则扮演了该信号和该验证器的角色。

sents.en: See Model as Author: naming the fix raised first-request repairs from 5 of 10 to 10 of 10.
sents.zh: 参见「以模型为作者」：对修复进行命名，使首次请求修复率从 10 例中的 5 例提升到 10 例中的 10 例。

sents.en: In the literature, self-correction without an external signal lowered accuracy, and the gains reported for self-refinement rested on oracle stopping signals ( Huang et al., 2024 ) ; back-prompting from a sound validator raised executable plans from about 12 % to 82 % in one planning domain ( Kambhampati et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 文献表明，在没有外部信号的情况下进行自我纠正会降低准确率，而自我改进所报告的收益依赖于理想停机信号（Huang 等，2024）；在某一规划领域中，由可靠的验证器进行反向提示，将可执行计划的比例从约 12% 提升到 82%（Kambhampati 等，2024）。

sents.en: The rules play the part of that signal and of that validator.
sents.zh: 这些规则扮演了该信号和该验证器的角色。

paragraphs.en: Let the rules decide the cases they cover, send what they leave open to a model or a person, and turn recurring answers into rules over time.
paragraphs.zh: 让规则决定它们所覆盖的案件，把它们未涵盖的部分交给模型或人来处理，并随着时间推移将反复出现的答案转化为规则。

paragraphs.en: Selective delegation, escalation cascade, tiered autonomy, rule distillation, human in the loop.
paragraphs.zh: 选择性委托、升级级联、分层自主、规则蒸馏、人在回路中。

paragraphs.en: Most cases of a claims process are routine and fully covered by rules; a few are ambiguous. Sending every case to a model costs money and gives up proofs where they were available; sending none leaves the ambiguous cases undecided. The pattern uses the rules’ own three-valued result as the gate: true and false are decided, unknown , unclear and conflicts are handed on.
paragraphs.zh: 理赔流程中的大多数案例都是常规性的，完全可以由规则覆盖；只有少数是模糊的。 把每个案例都发给模型会花钱，并且在本来有证明可用的地方放弃了证明；一个都不发则会让模糊的案例悬而未决。 该模式利用规则自身的三值结果作为门控：true（真）和 false（假）表示已决，unknown（未知）、unclear（不清晰）以及冲突的情况则被移交下去。

sents.en: Most cases of a claims process are routine and fully covered by rules; a few are ambiguous.
sents.zh: 理赔流程中的大多数案例都是常规性的，完全可以由规则覆盖；只有少数是模糊的。

sents.en: Sending every case to a model costs money and gives up proofs where they were available; sending none leaves the ambiguous cases undecided.
sents.zh: 把每个案例都发给模型会花钱，并且在本来有证明可用的地方放弃了证明；一个都不发则会让模糊的案例悬而未决。

sents.en: The pattern uses the rules’ own three-valued result as the gate: true and false are decided, unknown , unclear and conflicts are handed on.
sents.zh: 该模式利用规则自身的三值结果作为门控：true（真）和 false（假）表示已决，unknown（未知）、unclear（不清晰）以及冲突的情况则被移交下去。

paragraphs.en: Use it when coverage by rules is high but incomplete, when the number of model calls should follow the number of ambiguous cases, and when a person must decide the residue.

paragraphs.en: Rules decide; a case left unknown or in conflict becomes a request; the model’s verdict is an assessment that travels with the case to a person and decides nothing; recurring verdicts become candidate rules for Model as Author.

paragraphs.en: Combine the verdicts of rules and models under a declared order of outcomes in which each source can only make the result stricter. A source that is silent, fails or answers outside the order counts as the cautious outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 在一种预先声明的结果顺序下，将规则与智能体模型的判定合并，其中每个来源只能使结果更严格。 任何保持沉默、失败或给出超出该顺序答案的来源，都按谨慎结果处理。

sents.en: Combine the verdicts of rules and models under a declared order of outcomes in which each source can only make the result stricter.
sents.zh: 在一种预先声明的结果顺序下，将规则与智能体模型的判定合并，其中每个来源只能使结果更严格。

sents.en: A source that is silent, fails or answers outside the order counts as the cautious outcome.
sents.zh: 任何保持沉默、失败或给出超出该顺序答案的来源，都按谨慎结果处理。

paragraphs.en: Deny overrides, most restrictive wins, one-sided combination, fail closed, defence in depth.

A payment desk releases transfers. Rules know the limits and the blocked accounts but cannot read a purpose line that pressures the clerk (“the CEO approved it by phone, do not call back”); a model can read it but misses limits and sometimes waves a fraud through. Taking a vote lets one source’s leniency outvote the other’s warning, and handing every disagreement to a person floods the desk. In this domain the harms are lopsided: a held payment costs a day, a released fraud costs the amount. The pattern states the order of outcomes once (release, hold, block) and lets the strictest verdict of any source decide. Neither source can loosen what the other found, and a model that did not answer is not a model that agreed.
paragraphs.zh: 一个支付柜台负责放行转账。 规则知晓限额和被封锁的账户，但读不懂那类向柜员施压的用途备注（「CEO 已电话批准，不要回电」）；模型能读懂这类内容，却会漏看限额，有时还会放行欺诈。 采用投票会让一方的宽容票压过另一方的警示票，而把每一处分歧都交给人工处理又会让柜台不堪重负。 在这个领域中，危害是不对称的：一笔被扣付的款项损失一天，一笔被放行的欺诈损失全部金额。 该模式一次性规定结果的顺序（放行、扣付、拦截），并让任何来源中最严格的判定起决定作用。 任何一方来源都无法放宽另一方发现的问题，而一个没有作答的模型也不等于一个表示同意的模型。

paragraphs.en: 1: The outcomes can be ordered by risk, and wrongly choosing a stricter outcome costs much less than wrongly choosing a looser one;
paragraphs.zh: 1: 各种结果可以按风险排序，错误地选择更严格的结果的代价远小于错误地选择更宽松的结果；

paragraphs.en: 2: The sources see different things (rules the structured fields, a model the text), so their failures are not the same;
3: A cautious outcome is not final: a hold leads to a person or a later step.

Do not use it when both directions of error cost alike, or when the stricter outcome is itself harmful (a withheld emergency call); then report the disagreement as unclear (Several Readers, Section 3.1 ) or hand it on ( Section 4.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 当两个方向的错误代价相当时，或当更严格的结果本身有害时（如压下未拨出的紧急呼救电话），请勿使用它；此时应将该分歧报告为不明确（Several Readers，第 3.1 节），或将其移交出去（第 4.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: Rules : give their own verdict from the structured fields and combine all verdicts. Model : gives a verdict from the text, one of the ordered outcomes. Host : calls the model and records a failed call as such. Order : the outcomes with their rank, declared as facts. Person : takes up what is held.
paragraphs.zh: 规则：根据结构化字段给出各自裁定，并合并所有裁定。 模型：从文本给出裁定，即有序结果之一。 宿主：调用模型，并将失败的调用记录为失败。 顺序：各结果及其排名，以事实形式声明。 主体：承担所持有的内容。

paragraphs.en: Each source derives a verdict for each case. A source without a usable verdict (no receipt, a failed call, a word outside the order) is given the cautious verdict by a rule. The outcome is the verdict of highest rank, and the sources that gave it are named, so a person sees who held the payment and why.

paragraphs.en: Adding a source can only make the outcome stricter, so a new check never weakens the old ones, and a model outage stops releases instead of letting them through. The price is more held cases: every source’s false alarms add up, so the hold rate grows with each source and must be measured. Unlike a priority order, nothing is settled silently: the order is a fact in the program, and decidedBy names the source behind every outcome. The guarantee holds only if every branch moves toward the safe side, including the two that are easy to forget: a source that answers unclear must not let another source loosen the outcome, and a failed call must not count as agreement. One branch that does either breaks the whole union. In the hackathon below, a comparison system recorded an unreachable judge as yes , a submission a reply that was not JSON as clean .
paragraphs.zh: 增加一个来源只会让结果更严格，因此新的检查绝不会削弱旧的检查，而某个模型故障会导致发布被阻止，而不是被放行。 代价是更多被搁置的案例：每个来源的误报会累加，因此搁置率会随着每个来源的增加而上升，必须加以度量。 与优先级排序不同，没有任何事情被悄悄定下：顺序是程序中的一个事实，而 decidedBy 指明每个结果背后的来源。 只有当每个分支都朝安全的一侧移动时，该保证才成立，其中包括两个容易被遗忘的分支：一个回答不明确的来源不得让另一个来源放宽结果，一次失败的调用不得被视为同意。 任何一个分支违反这两点，都会破坏整个并集。 在下面的黑客马拉松中，一个比较系统把一名无法联系到的评审记录为 yes ，把一份回复不是 JSON 的提交记录为 clean 。

paragraphs.en: Several Readers, One Rule ( Section 3.1 ) makes a disagreement unclear ; this pattern resolves it toward the safe side by a declared order. Model Proposes, Rules Dispose ( Section 4.1 ) lets only the rules refuse; here the model may refuse too, but never admit. Division by Competence ( Section 4.4 ) takes up what is held.
paragraphs.zh: 「多个读者，一条规则」（第3.1节）会造成分歧不明确；本模式通过声明一个优先顺序，将分歧化解到安全的一侧。 「模型提议，规则裁决」（第4.1节）只允许规则拒绝；此处模型也可以拒绝，但绝不承认。 「按能力分工」（第4.4节）承担已掌握的部分。

paragraphs.en: Strict union. A failed call counts as the cautious outcome, as in the program above. Rule floor. A failed call leaves only the rules’ verdict, but never less than it: the model can only add findings, and an outage falls back to the rules instead of to the safe outcome. Use the floor when holding everything during an outage costs more than the rules alone miss, and say in the outcome that the model was absent.
paragraphs.zh: 严格并集。 调用失败算作谨慎结果，如上面的程序所示。规则下限。 调用失败时只保留规则的判定，但绝不会少于它：模型只能补充发现，而中断时会回退到规则而不是回退到安全结果。 当在服务中断期间保留所有内容、其代价高于仅用规则所遗漏的内容时，使用下限，并在结果中注明模型缺席。

paragraphs.en: The program is checked against recorded receipts only; FrameX has no measurement of its own. Figures from the hackathon are taken from result files committed in the submissions’ repositories at a named commit; we did not rerun them, and figures that appear only in a README, report or pitch are left out. In an invoice-payment agent (Apertus v1.5 8B, 500 synthetic invoices, 300 of which must not be paid), the model alone paid 178 of the 300, code checks alone 89, and the strict union none (95 % CI 0–1.3 %); it held 7 of 200 legitimate invoices, against 2 for the model alone. On a set run blind before later checks were added, the figures were 337, 174 and 29 of 600. In redaction of personal data (8B, 300 synthetic documents, 1,860 entities), recall was 38.7 % for rules, 57.7 % for the model and 78.5 % for the union, and 81 % of documents still leaked at least one entity: the union is stricter than each source, not safe by itself.
paragraphs.zh: 该程序仅依据记录的回执进行检查；FrameX 自身没有测量手段。 黑客马拉松的数据取自提交仓库中指定提交（commit）的结果文件；我们没有重新运行这些程序，仅出现在 README、报告或路演材料中的数字不予采用。 在一个发票支付智能体（Apertus v1.5 8B，500 张合成发票，其中 300 张不得支付）中，仅用模型时支付了 300 张中的 178 张，仅用代码检查时支付了 89 张，严格并集则为零（95% 置信区间 0–1.3%）；它在 200 张合法发票中拦下了 7 张，而仅用模型时为 2 张。 在后来加入检查之前盲测运行的一组数据中，600 张里对应数字分别为 337、174 和 29。 在个人数据脱敏任务中（8B，300 份合成文档，1,860 个实体），召回率分别为：规则 38.7%，模型 57.7%，并集 78.5%，且 81% 的文档仍泄露了至少一个实体：并集比每个单独来源更严格，但本身并不安全。

paragraphs.en: Let the model propose what might be the case (a cause, a missing document, an explanation) and let the rules test each proposal in a copy of the session and ask for the evidence that decides between them. A hypothesis never becomes a fact.
paragraphs.zh: 让模型提出可能的情形（一个原因、一份缺失的文档、一种解释），并让规则在会话的副本中检验每个提议，同时索取能在它们之间做出裁决的证据。 假设永远不会成为事实。

sents.zh: 假设永远不会成为事实。

paragraphs.en: Abduction with a model, diagnosis, candidate generation and test.
paragraphs.zh: 基于模型的溯因、诊断、候选生成与测试。

paragraphs.en: A bank reconciliation shows a difference between the ledger and the bank statement. A model suggests causes (a fee, a transposed amount, a payment booked on the wrong day); each is plausible. The rules can test each: assumed in a copy, does it explain the difference without violating a constraint? The surviving candidates become questions, and only the answer decides.
paragraphs.zh: 银行调节表显示账簿与银行对账单之间存在差异。 模型会提出若干可能原因（一笔手续费、一个数字错位、一笔记错日期的付款）；每一种都看似合理。 规则可以逐一检验：假设其中某个原因成立，它能否在不违反约束的情况下解释这一差异？ 幸存的候选原因转化为问题，而只有答案才能作出裁决。

paragraphs.en: Use it for diagnosis, reconciliation, investigation and unknown goals, where generating candidates needs world knowledge but testing them needs exactness.
paragraphs.zh: 将其用于诊断、对账、调查和未知目标等场景——这些场景中，生成候选方案需要世界知识，而验证候选方案则需要精确性。

paragraphs.en: Model (proposes candidates marked hypothetical); Rules (test each in a copy, derive evidence questions); Person or a source (answers the deciding question).
paragraphs.zh: 模型（提出标记为假设的候选方案）；规则（在副本中逐一检验，推导出证据问题）；人或信息来源（回答起决定作用的问题）。

paragraphs.en: Candidates arrive as receipts. In the full pattern each is previewed in a copy of the session; rules keep those that derive every observation and violate nothing; the evidence search names the one to four answers that would decide.
paragraphs.zh: 候选以回执的形式到达。 在完整模式中，每个候选都在会话的副本中被预演；规则保留那些能推导出所有观察且不违反任何规则的候选；证据搜索会指出一到四个能够做出决断的答案。

paragraphs.en: Hypotheses are cheap to generate and never pollute the knowledge base. The search is bounded; an incomplete search is never a claim that no explanation exists.
paragraphs.zh: 假设生成成本低廉，且绝不会污染知识库。 搜索是有边界的；不完整的搜索绝不意味着断言不存在任何解释。

paragraphs.en: Ask the model for candidates as rows, keep each as a hypothesis keyed by its row number, refute it by rule, and ask about the survivors only; a refuted candidate never becomes a fact. The question itself goes to a person through a flow ( Section 4.2 ). From the bank reconciliation:

paragraphs.en: Figure 10 draws the program as a rule graph. This program tests every candidate with one rule, its amount. A fuller test assumes each candidate in a copy of the session ( preview ) and keeps it only if it derives the observation without violating a constraint, and the evidence search ( _evidence_needs ) names the answers that would decide. The recorded run shows why the test should be as strong as the domain allows: four of five candidates passed the amount test, among them an “unrecorded deposit” whose direction contradicts the ledger.
paragraphs.zh: 图 10 将该程序绘制为规则图。 该程序用一条规则（其金额）测试每个候选。 更完整的测试假设每个候选都处于会话的一个副本（ preview ）中，并且仅当它在不违反约束的情况下推导出该观察结果时才保留它，而证据搜索（ _evidence_needs ）会列出能够做出判定的答案。 记录的运行结果说明了为什么测试应尽可能结合领域允许的强度：五个候选中有四个通过了金额测试，其中包括一个“未记录存款”，其方向与账目相矛盾。

paragraphs.en: Let the model review what the rules hold or conclude (a policy change, a rule against its source text, a surprising decision); its critique opens a review and never changes a rule or a conclusion.
paragraphs.zh: 让模型审查规则所支持或得出的内容（政策变更、与其源文本相悖的规则、令人意外的决定）；其批评会开启一次审查，但绝不直接更改规则或结论。

paragraphs.en: Policy critic, plausibility review, two-channel cross-check.
paragraphs.zh: 策略评论员、合理性审查、双通道交叉核验。

paragraphs.en: A policy change passes every regression case and still changes the decision for a case nobody expected. The change’s author wrote a rationale; a model can read the changed decisions against it and flag what looks inconsistent. Its remarks may be wrong, so they open a review that a person disposes of.
paragraphs.zh: 一项政策变更通过了每一个回归测试用例，却仍然改变了某个没人预料到的案例的决策。 变更的作者撰写了一份理由说明；模型可以对照该说明审读被更改的决策，并标记出看起来不一致的地方。 它的评语可能有误，因此这些评语会开启一项由人来最终裁决的审查。

sents.zh: 一项政策变更通过了每一个回归测试用例，却仍然改变了某个没人预料到的案例的决策。

paragraphs.en: Use it where checks are incomplete: semantic faults, fidelity of a rule to the text it cites, plausibility of changed decisions before a release.
paragraphs.zh: 在检查不完整的地方使用它：语义错误、规则与其所引用文本的一致性、发布前对已变更决策的合理性审查。

paragraphs.en: Model (critic); Rules (keep a remark only if it names a case and quotes the rationale verbatim; flag declared invariants without a model; gate approval); Reviewer (disposes of every finding).
paragraphs.zh: 模型（评审者）；规则（仅当某条意见指明了具体案例并逐字引用了理由时才保留该意见；在没有模型的情况下标记已声明的不变量；把关批准）；审阅者（处置每一条发现）。

paragraphs.en: A sealed before-and-after review of the policy is the critic’s input; grounded remarks become findings; approval is derived only after every finding is disposed of. A corrected rule proposed by the critic is checked like any draft.
paragraphs.zh: 对该策略的密封式前后对照评审是评审者的输入；有依据的意见成为发现项；只有当每个发现项都被处置完毕后才得出批准结论。 评审者提出的修正规则会像任何草案一样接受检查。

paragraphs.en: The critic adds recall where checks are incomplete; its false remarks cost reviewer time, so grounding requirements filter them. It never weakens a complete check.
paragraphs.zh: 批评者在检查不完整时补充召回内容；其虚假言论会耗费审查者时间，因此需要接地要求来过滤它们。 它绝不会削弱已完成的检查。

paragraphs.en: In a pilot study with gpt-oss:20b , 20 changes over 10 rule domains were each reviewed three times. In the 10 changes with one seeded decision that contradicts the rationale, the critic found it in 29 of 30 reviews; in the 10 clean changes it made no remark in 29 of 30. All 34 of its remarks quoted the rationale verbatim, so the quote check removed nothing. The changes were short and each defect was stated plainly; harder defects and longer reviews are not yet measured. In the checking study, model reviews found contradictory rules and unknown facts almost always, but a missing rule in only 3 of 10 rule reviews at 64 rules and in none of the code or prompt reviews, so a critic belongs on top of the checks.
paragraphs.zh: 在一项使用 gpt-oss:20b 的试点研究中，覆盖 10 个规则领域的 20 处更改分别被评审了三次。 在 10 处包含一个与理由相矛盾的预设决策的更改中，批评者在 30 次评审中的 29 次发现了它；而在 10 处无缺陷的更改中，它在 30 次评审中的 29 次未提出任何意见。 它提出的全部 34 条意见都逐字引用了理由，因此引用检查没有删除任何内容。 这些更改都很简短，且每个缺陷都表述明确；更难的缺陷和更长的评审尚未测量。 在检查研究中，模型评审几乎总能发现相互矛盾的规则和未知事实，但在 64 条规则下仅在 10 次规则评审中的 3 次发现缺失的规则，在代码或提示词评审中则一次也没有发现，因此批评者应当叠加在检查之上。

paragraphs.en: Let the rules supply labels, rule-selected worked examples and grades, with proofs, so that knowledge flows into the model’s context or weights; the rules stay in production as the independent check.

paragraphs.zh: 作为标签和评分器的规则、由规则筛选的示例、由规则提供信息的偏好数据。

paragraphs.en: A model that must answer admission questions can be shown worked cases. Which cases, and whether its answers are right, the rules know: they label generated cases with decisions and proofs, select the examples closest to the current case, and grade the answers.
paragraphs.zh: 一个必须回答准入问题的模型可以向其展示已解决的案例。 展示哪些案例，以及其答案是否正确，规则是知道的：它们用裁决和证明来标注生成的案例，选择与当前案例最接近的示例，并对答案进行评分。

paragraphs.en: The rules label every generated case with its decision and the missing requirements; the model answers each case; a rule grades the answer against the label and records each gap the answer missed. Labels and grades, with their proofs, leave the engine as training or evaluation data, and after training the same rules grade the taught model.

paragraphs.zh: 一次演示运行；尚未进行测量。

paragraphs.en: Keep what an assistant learns across conversations as statements that rules admit, supersede and withdraw, and let rules decide which remembered statements enter the next prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 将智能体在对话之间学到的内容保留为规则可承认、取代和撤回的陈述，并让规则决定哪些被记住的陈述进入下一个提示。

paragraphs.en: Agent memory, long-term memory, memory handler, belief revision with a model as source.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体记忆、长期记忆、记忆处理器、以模型为来源的信念修正。

paragraphs.en: An advisor learns in March that a student prefers German and in May that English is fine; in June the student asks it to forget a message. A model that keeps its own notes either keeps both values or overwrites one, cannot say which holds or why, and its notes quietly become records: a grade mentioned in a chat sits next to the grade on the transcript. A single reading ( Section 3.1 ) decides whether a statement holds now; memory must decide whether it still holds later. The pattern keeps every remembered statement with its utterance and quote, lets a slot policy decide which sources may establish which facts, lets a newer admitted statement supersede an older one without deleting it, and recomputes what rests on an utterance when that utterance is forgotten. Rules choose what the model sees next, with a similarity score as one input, and the model cites the statements it used.
paragraphs.zh: 一位导师在三月份得知某学生偏好德语，五月份又得知英语也可以；六月该学生要求它忘记一条消息。 一个保留自己笔记的模型要么同时保留两个值，要么覆盖其中一个，无法说明哪个值有效或为什么，它的笔记悄悄变成了记录：聊天中提到的成绩就放在成绩单上的成绩旁边。 一次读取（第 3.1 节）决定一条陈述现在是否成立；记忆必须决定它之后是否仍然成立。 该模式将每条被记住的陈述与其话语和引文一起保留，让槽位策略决定哪些来源可以确立哪些事实，让一条较新的被接纳陈述取代较旧的陈述而不删除它，并在某条话语被遗忘时重新计算依赖该话语的内容。 规则选择模型接下来看到的内容，相似度分数是其中一个输入，模型会引用它所使用的陈述。

sents.en: A single reading ( Section 3.1 ) decides whether a statement holds now; memory must decide whether it still holds later.
sents.zh: 一次读取（第 3.1 节）决定一条陈述现在是否成立；记忆必须决定它之后是否仍然成立。

sents.en: The pattern keeps every remembered statement with its utterance and quote, lets a slot policy decide which sources may establish which facts, lets a newer admitted statement supersede an older one without deleting it, and recomputes what rests on an utterance when that utterance is forgotten.
sents.zh: 该模式将每条被记住的陈述与其话语和引文一起保留，让槽位策略决定哪些来源可以确立哪些事实，让一条较新的被接纳陈述取代较旧的陈述而不删除它，并在某条话语被遗忘时重新计算依赖该话语的内容。

sents.en: Rules choose what the model sees next, with a similarity score as one input, and the model cites the statements it used.
sents.zh: 规则选择模型接下来看到的内容，相似度分数是其中一个输入，模型会引用它所使用的陈述。

paragraphs.en: an assistant serves the same person or case across sessions;
paragraphs.zh: 助手在多个会话中服务于同一个人或同一个案件；

paragraphs.en: what is known changes over time, and the history of a value matters;
paragraphs.zh: 已知的内容会随时间变化，并且值的历史是有意义的；

paragraphs.en: sources differ in what they may establish (a chat may set a preference, only a certificate a qualification);
paragraphs.zh: 来源在它们可能确立的内容上有所不同（聊天可以设定偏好，而只有证书才能确立资格）；

paragraphs.en: a request to forget must take effect on everything that rested on the forgotten input.
paragraphs.zh: 遗忘请求必须对基于被遗忘输入而建立的一切内容生效。

paragraphs.en: For a single session a Sensor suffices. Retrieval by similarity over documents is the task of a retriever outside the engine; its results enter as receipts like any other.
paragraphs.zh: 对于单个会话，一个传感器就足够了。 基于相似度对文档进行检索是引擎之外的检索器的任务；其结果像其他内容一样以回执的形式进入。

paragraphs.en: Model : proposes statements with quotes from an utterance, and later cites the statements it used. Rules : slot policy, admission, supersession, withdrawal, and the selection of statements for a prompt. Host : stores utterances and receipts, measures quotes, removes the content of a forgotten utterance. Person : states, corrects, asks to forget.
paragraphs.zh: 模型：提出带有来自话语引用的陈述，并在之后引用其使用过的陈述。 规则：槽位策略、准入、取代、撤回，以及用于提示的陈述选择。 宿主：存储话语和回执，度量引用，移除被遗忘话语的内容。 用户：陈述、更正、要求遗忘。

sents.en: Person : states, corrects, asks to forget.
sents.zh: 用户：陈述、更正、要求遗忘。

paragraphs.en: Each utterance triggers a Sensor request; the proposed statements return as receipts; rules admit them per slot; supersession follows the order of admission, and the current value is a query. A request to forget marks the utterance; in the next derivation every statement that rested on it loses its acceptance, and an older statement can become current again. Before a model call, a steering rule ( Section 4.2 ) selects the current statements the step needs; the reply cites their identifiers, and a rule checks that every cited statement is current.
paragraphs.zh: 每条话语都会触发一次传感器请求；被提议的陈述作为回执返回；规则按槽位接纳它们；取代遵循接纳顺序，当前值即一次查询。 遗忘请求会标记该话语；在下一次推导中，所有基于它的陈述都失去其被接受状态，较早的陈述可以重新成为当前陈述。 在模型调用之前，一条引导规则（第 4.2 节）选出该步骤所需的当前陈述；回复引用它们的标识符，并由一条规则检查每个被引用的陈述是否为当前陈述。

paragraphs.en: Every remembered value has an utterance, a quote, a date and a history. Forgetting is exact without manual clean-up, because acceptance is derived and recomputed. A chat cannot establish what its source may not, and a derived fact such as an admission is never written to memory. The cost is one Sensor call per utterance and a store that grows, since only a request to forget removes content. A statement admitted wrongly holds until it is superseded or forgotten, and a conflict between sources needs a person ( Section 4.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 每个被记住的值都有一条话语、一段引文、一个日期和一条历史记录。 遗忘是精确的，无需手动清理，因为接受是由推导得出并重新计算的。 聊天无法确立其来源无法确立的内容，且诸如承认之类的推导事实永远不会写入记忆。 代价是每条话语一次传感器调用以及一个不断增长的存储，因为只有请求遗忘才会删除内容。 一条被错误接受的话语会一直保留，直到它被取代或被遗忘，而来源之间的冲突需要人（第 4.4 节）介入。

paragraphs.en: Storing is Model as Sensor ( Section 3.1 ) applied to utterances over time; recall is Rules Steer the Model ( Section 4.2 ); conflicts go to Division by Competence ( Section 4.4 ); a reply that cites a superseded statement is repaired by Critique and Repair ( Section 4.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 存储是将「模型作为传感器」（第 3.1 节）应用于随时间推移的话语；召回是「规则引导模型」（第 4.2 节）；冲突交由「按能力分工」（第 4.4 节）处理；而引用了已被取代的陈述的回复，则通过「批判与修复」（第 4.3 节）进行修正。

paragraphs.en: Five couplings recur in working systems and break an invariant of Section 2 . Each looks like one of the patterns above, which is why it survives review. We name them so that a design review can look for them; each entry says what it looks like, what it breaks and which pattern replaces it. Most of them were named in the jury assessments of the hackathon of Sections 3.4 and 4.5 ; the first is the one that Critique and Repair already excludes by name.

paragraphs.en: Code outside the rules changes a verdict before the rules see it: a regular expression in the host that turns a judge’s no into yes , a post-processing step that corrects a value. The outcome may be right, but the proof does not contain the step that decided it, and nobody can tell the correction from the model. It breaks invariant 3, and Critique and Repair ( Section 4.3 ) excludes it by name. In a comparison system built for the hackathon, checked in its code, a host function rewrote the judge’s reply before it became a receipt: yes became no when a pattern found the answer vague, which only tightens; but unclear was settled by the pattern in either direction, and an unreachable model was recorded as yes . Only a note in the reason text was left, and the rules saw the corrected verdict alone. Instead, write the correction as a rule that reads the receipt, so that explain shows it; if the correction can only make the outcome stricter, it is a source in a Fail-Safe Union ( Section 4.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 规则之外的代码会在规则看到裁决之前改变它：宿主中的一个正则表达式把评审的“否”变成“是”，一个后处理步骤修正某个值。 结果可能是对的，但证据中并不包含做出决定的那一步，而且没人能从模型中分辨出这次修正。 它破坏了不变式 3，而批判与修复（第 4.3 节）明确按名称将其排除。 在一个为黑客松构建、其代码已提交的比较系统中，一个宿主函数在评审的回复成为回执之前对其进行了改写：当某个模式发现答案含糊时，“是”会变成“否”，这只会收紧结果；但“不清楚”在任一方向上都会被该模式判定，而无法连接的模型则被记录为“是”。 只有原因文本中的一条注释留存下来，而规则看到的只有被修正后的裁决。 相反，应把修正写成一条读取回执的规则，这样解释功能就能展示它；如果修正只会让结果更严格，它就是故障安全并集（第 4.5 节）中的一个来源。

sents.en: Code outside the rules changes a verdict before the rules see it: a regular expression in the host that turns a judge’s no into yes , a post-processing step that corrects a value.
sents.zh: 规则之外的代码会在规则看到裁决之前改变它：宿主中的一个正则表达式把评审的“否”变成“是”，一个后处理步骤修正某个值。

sents.en: The outcome may be right, but the proof does not contain the step that decided it, and nobody can tell the correction from the model.
sents.zh: 结果可能是对的，但证据中并不包含做出决定的那一步，而且没人能从模型中分辨出这次修正。

sents.en: It breaks invariant 3, and Critique and Repair ( Section 4.3 ) excludes it by name.
sents.zh: 它破坏了不变式 3，而批判与修复（第 4.3 节）明确按名称将其排除。

sents.en: In a comparison system built for the hackathon, checked in its code, a host function rewrote the judge’s reply before it became a receipt: yes became no when a pattern found the answer vague, which only tightens; but unclear was settled by the pattern in either direction, and an unreachable model was recorded as yes .
sents.zh: 在一个为黑客松构建、其代码已提交的比较系统中，一个宿主函数在评审的回复成为回执之前对其进行了改写：当某个模式发现答案含糊时，“是”会变成“否”，这只会收紧结果；但“不清楚”在任一方向上都会被该模式判定，而无法连接的模型则被记录为“是”。

sents.en: Only a note in the reason text was left, and the rules saw the corrected verdict alone.
sents.zh: 只有原因文本中的一条注释留存下来，而规则看到的只有被修正后的裁决。

sents.en: Instead, write the correction as a rule that reads the receipt, so that explain shows it; if the correction can only make the outcome stricter, it is a source in a Fail-Safe Union ( Section 4.5 ).
sents.zh: 相反，应把修正写成一条读取回执的规则，这样解释功能就能展示它；如果修正只会让结果更严格，它就是故障安全并集（第 4.5 节）中的一个来源。

paragraphs.en: The cases or the gold labels that measure a coupling come from the model, the prompt or the developer that is being measured, or the criteria are chosen after the results are seen. The numbers then measure agreement with oneself. It breaks the claim behind every Evidence heading. Instead, fix the cases, the truths and the criteria before the first model call, and derive labels by rules or by construction: an injected fault, a value read from an exact source (Rules Teach the Model, Section 5.3 , and C3 in Section 9 ).
paragraphs.zh: 用于衡量某种耦合的测试用例或金标准标签来自被衡量的模型、提示词或开发者，或者评判标准是在看到结果之后才选定的。 这样一来，这些数字衡量的只是与自身的一致性。 这会破坏每个「证据」标题背后的主张。 相反，应在第一次调用模型之前就固定用例、真值和评判标准，并通过规则或构造方式得出标签：例如注入的故障、从精确来源读取的值（参见「规则教会模型」第 5.3 节，以及第 9 节中的 C3）。

paragraphs.en: The model that wrote an answer, or a model of the same family with the same prompt, judges whether the answer is right. Its errors and its judgement fail together, and self-correction without an external signal does not help ( Huang et al., 2024 ) . It breaks the independence that Several Readers, One Rule ( Section 3.1 ) and the Read-Back Check ( Section 3.3 ) require. Instead, let a rule check what can be checked, and use a different model or a different prompt for the rest ( Sections 4.3 and 5.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 由写出该答案的模型，或使用相同提示词的同族模型，来判断答案是否正确。 它的错误与它的判断会一同失效，缺乏外部信号时自我纠错也无济于事（Huang et al., 2024）。 这破坏了“多名读者、一条规则”（第 3.1 节）与“回读检查”（第 3.3 节）所要求的独立性。 相反，应让规则检查可检查的部分，对其余部分使用不同的模型或不同的提示词（第 4.3 节和第 5.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: The policy that decides exists only as sentences in a prompt. Nothing can test it, a change cannot be reviewed against cases, and an answer cannot show which sentence it followed. It breaks invariant 3 and leaves the guide’s first question unanswered ( Section 10 ). Instead, turn the policy into rules with Model as Author ( Section 3.2 ) and let Rules Steer the Model ( Section 4.2 ) put into the prompt only what one step needs.
paragraphs.zh: 决定策略只以提示词中的句子的形式存在。 没有什么能测试它，变更无法对照用例进行评审，答案也无法表明它遵循了哪一条句子。 这破坏了不变量3，并且没有回答指南的第一个问题（ 第10节 ）。 相反，将策略转化为规则，采用「模型作为作者」（ 第3.2节 ），并让「规则引导模型」（ 第4.2节 ）只把单步所需的内容放入提示词中。

paragraphs.en: A check is computed and recorded, but nothing depends on it: a quoteFound that no rule reads, a confidence that is logged, a validation whose failure still lets the action through. It looks like evidence in a review and changes no outcome. It breaks invariant 4. Instead, let an acceptance rule read every check, and look for receipt fields without an outgoing arrow in the rule graph ( Appendix C ).
paragraphs.zh: 计算并记录了一项检查，但没有任何东西依赖它：一个没有任何规则读取的 quoteFound、一个仅被记录日志的置信度、一个即使失败仍放行动作的验证。 它在审查中看起来像证据，却不改变任何结果。它违反了不变式 4。 相反，应让一条验收规则读取每一项检查，并在规则图中查找没有出边指向其他节点的回执字段（附录 C）。

paragraphs.en: Two bodies of work describe couplings of learning and reasoning. Neuro-symbolic research classifies how a learned and a symbolic component are combined, from Kautz’s six types ( Kautz, 2022 ) to the boxology of van Harmelen and ten Teije (2019) , its modular taxonomy ( van Bekkum et al., 2021 ) and its extension to language models ( de Boer et al., 2025 ) , and from the roadmap that unifies language models and knowledge graphs ( Pan et al., 2024 ) to recent surveys ( d’Avila Garcez and Lamb, 2023 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Rani et al., 2026 ) . Software engineering for model-based systems collects architectural patterns for agents ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , practitioners’ workflow patterns ( Schluntz and Zhang, 2024 ) , guardrail toolkits ( Rebedea et al., 2023 ) and design patterns for machine-learning applications ( Washizaki et al., 2020 ; Washizaki et al., 2022 ) . Between them lie systems in which a model translates for a solver ( Pan et al., 2023 ; Olausson et al., 2023 ; Ye et al., 2023 ) or generates candidates for sound critics ( Kambhampati et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 有两类研究工作描述了学习与推理的耦合。 神经符号研究对学习组件与符号组件的结合方式进行了分类，从 Kautz 的六种类型（Kautz, 2022）到 van Harmelen 和 ten Teije（2019）的框图学（boxology）、其模块化分类法（van Bekkum et al., 2021）及其向语言模型的扩展（de Boer et al., 2025），从统一语言模型与知识图谱的路线图（Pan et al., 2024）到近期的综述（d'Avila Garcez and Lamb, 2023；Yang et al., 2025；Rani et al., 2026）。 面向基于模型的系统的软件工程收集了智能体的架构模式（Liu et al., 2025）、从业者的工作流模式（Schluntz and Zhang, 2024）、防护栏工具包（Rebedea et al., 2023）以及机器学习应用的设计模式（Washizaki et al., 2020；Washizaki et al., 2022）。 介于两者之间的是这样一些系统：模型为求解器进行翻译（Pan et al., 2023；Olausson et al., 2023；Ye et al., 2023），或为可靠的评判器生成候选解（Kambhampati et al., 2024）。

sents.en: Two bodies of work describe couplings of learning and reasoning.
sents.zh: 有两类研究工作描述了学习与推理的耦合。

paragraphs.en: The boxology began with van Harmelen and ten Teije (2019) : ovals for processes, either deductive (KR) or inductive (ML), and boxes for the symbols or data that processes consume and produce. van Bekkum et al. (2021) refined it into a vocabulary of four kinds of node, instances (rectangles, data or symbols), models (hexagons, statistical or semantic), processes (ovals: generate, transform, infer) and actors (triangles), and into elementary patterns that compose. de Boer et al. (2025) added the generative model, with an elementary pattern in which a model infers new data from data; the earlier patterns let a model infer only symbols or models, which cannot describe a language model that writes text.
paragraphs.zh: 这一框图体系始于 van Harmelen 和 ten Teije（2019）：椭圆表示过程，可以是演绎的（知识表示）或归纳的（机器学习），方框表示过程所消耗和产生的符号或数据。van Bekkum 等人 （2021）将其细化为一套包含四类节点的词汇表：实例（矩形，表示数据或符号）、模型（六边形，表示统计模型或语义模型）、过程（椭圆：生成、变换、推理）以及参与者（三角形），并细化为可组合的基本模式。de Boer 等人 （2025）增加了生成式模型，其基本模式是模型从数据推断出新数据；早期的模式只允许模型推断符号或模型，因而无法描述一个能写出文本的语言模型。

paragraphs.en: Every pattern in this catalogue carries its structure in this notation, with model:gen for the language model and model:sem for the rule base, and one mark of ours, the dashed request arrow ( Section 2.3 and the legend in the catalogue form).
paragraphs.zh: 本目录中的每个模式都以此记法承载其结构，其中 model:gen 表示语言模型，model:sem 表示规则库，另有一个我们自定义的标记，即虚线请求箭头（参见第 2.3 节及目录形式中的图例）。

paragraphs.en: The drawings show what the notation captures and what it leaves out.
paragraphs.zh: 这些图示展示了该表示法捕捉到了什么，又遗漏了什么。

paragraphs.en: In the Sensor ( Section 3.1 ) the model’s reply is text, that is data; it becomes symbols only through a transformation, which is our receipt, and the rules then infer which symbols count. The notation shows this shape. It cannot show that the first symbol box holds proposals and the second accepted facts, refusals with their reason and unknown values; the labels below the boxes add that.
paragraphs.zh: 在传感器（第3.1节）中，模型的回复是文本，也就是数据；它只有经过一次转换才成为符号，这个转换就是我们的回执，然后规则据此推断哪些符号有效。 该图示展示了这一结构。 它无法表明第一个符号框里放的是提案，第二个框里放的是已接受的事实、附带理由的拒绝以及未知值；框下方的标签补充说明了这些内容。

paragraphs.en: In Model as Author ( Section 3.2 ) the generative model produces a semantic model, the draft rule, which an inference with the checker and the cases evaluates; an expert adopts it through the elementary pattern in which an actor engineers a model.
paragraphs.zh: 在“模型作为作者”（第 3.2 节）中，生成式模型产出一个语义模型，即草稿规则，随后由一次结合检查器与案例的推理对其进行评估；专家通过“行动者工程化一个模型”这一基本模式来采纳该规则。

paragraphs.en: In Rules Steer the Model ( Section 4.2 ) the rules derive the step, one generative model phrases the question, a person answers and a second generative model judges the answer. The closest named pattern is meta-reasoning for control, a symbolic process that directs a learned one; here it does so step by step through a conversation.
paragraphs.zh: 在《规则引导模型》（第4.2节）中，规则推导出步骤，一个生成式模型提出问题，一个人作出回答，然后第二个生成式模型评判该回答。 与之最接近的已命名模式是用于控制的元推理（meta-reasoning for control），即一个符号化过程引导一个学习到的过程；在这里，它通过对话逐步实现这一引导。

sents.en: In Rules Steer the Model ( Section 4.2 ) the rules derive the step, one generative model phrases the question, a person answers and a second generative model judges the answer.
sents.zh: 在《规则引导模型》（第4.2节）中，规则推导出步骤，一个生成式模型提出问题，一个人作出回答，然后第二个生成式模型评判该回答。

sents.en: The closest named pattern is meta-reasoning for control, a symbolic process that directs a learned one; here it does so step by step through a conversation.
sents.zh: 与之最接近的已命名模式是用于控制的元推理（meta-reasoning for control），即一个符号化过程引导一个学习到的过程；在这里，它通过对话逐步实现这一引导。

paragraphs.en: In Rules Teach the Model ( Section 5.3 ) the labels derived by the rules enter the training of the model, the shape of informed learning with prior knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 在“规则教导模型”（第 5.3 节）中，由规则得出的标签进入模型的训练，即以先验知识进行信息引导式学习的形态。

paragraphs.en: Model Proposes, Rules Dispose ( Section 4.1 ), Critique and Repair ( Section 4.3 ) and Rule-Governed Memory ( Section 6.1 ) are loops; the notation draws the arrow back, but the bound, the order of the steps and the supersession of one value by a later one are rules that the drawing cannot show.
paragraphs.zh: 「模型提议，规则裁断」（第4.1节）、「批判与修复」（第4.3节）以及「规则治理的记忆」（第6.1节）都是循环；图示把箭头画了回去，但边界、步骤的顺序以及后值对先前值的取代，都是这幅图无法呈现的规则。

paragraphs.en: Three things the boxes and arrows cannot say are the subject of this catalogue: the direction of control, which the dashed arrows add; the status of a symbol (proposed, accepted, refused, unknown ) with its date and source; and repetition over time, a retry, a next step or a later supersession. de Boer et al. (2025) name the last gap themselves, and they observe that the notation often yields several drawings of the same system. The four elementary moves of Section 2.3 supply all three: a request carries control, a receipt carries date and source, and accept and ask carry the status.
paragraphs.zh: 方框与箭头无法表达的三件事正是本目录的主题：控制的方向，由虚线箭头补充表示；符号的状态（提议、接受、拒绝、未知）及其日期与来源；以及随时间的重复，即重试、下一步操作或后续的取代。de Boer 等人 （2025）自行指出了最后这一空白，并观察到这种记法往往会对同一个系统产生多幅不同的图。 第 2.3 节的四个基本动作提供了这三者：请求传递控制，回执携带日期与来源，而接受与询问表达状态。

paragraphs.en: Most published systems let the model drive and call a solver or a tool: Kautz’s Neuro[Symbolic], ReAct ( Yao et al., 2023 ) , Toolformer ( Schick et al., 2023 ) , Logic-LM and LLM-Modulo. All thirteen patterns here are Symbolic[Neuro]: the rules issue requests and the model is a subroutine whose answers return as data. We chose this direction deliberately, for accountability. The agenda of d’Avila Garcez and Lamb (2023) names trust and accountability as aims of tight integration, and loose coupling with explicit provenance reaches both without tight integration.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数已发表的系统的做法是让模型主导并调用求解器或工具：Kautz 的 Neuro[Symbolic]、ReAct（Yao et al., 2023）、Toolformer（Schick et al., 2023）、Logic-LM 以及 LLM-Modulo。 本文的全部十三个模式都是 Symbolic[Neuro]：规则发出请求，而模型是一个子程序，其返回结果作为数据传回。 我们是有意选择这个方向的，目的是为了可问责性。 d'Avila Garcez 与 Lamb（2023）的研究议程将信任与可问责性列为深度整合的目标，而带有明确溯源的松散耦合无需深度整合即可同时达成这两点。

paragraphs.en: de Boer et al. (2025) state that temporal, recurring or iterative aspects “have not yet been taken into account and can currently not be visualised adequately” in the boxology, and that the same system can be drawn in several ways. Patterns 5, 6 and 8 are iterative by nature, and the dated receipt gives each iteration an identity, an order and a record. Pattern 11 makes time its subject: supersession, withdrawal and the current value as a query are rules over that order.
paragraphs.zh: de Boer 等人 (2025) 指出，时间性、重复性或迭代性的方面在框图法中“尚未被纳入考虑，目前也无法得到充分的可视化”，并且同一个系统可以以多种方式绘制。 模式 5、6 和 8 本质上是迭代式的，而带日期的回执为每次迭代赋予了身份、顺序和记录。 模式 11 将时间作为其主题：取代、撤回以及作为查询的当前值，都是针对该顺序的规则。

sents.en: de Boer et al.

paragraphs.en: None of the sources above distinguishes a failed call, a malformed reply, an unclear judgement and a logical unknown , and none of them makes every model answer a replayable observation. These are the invariants of Section 2 , and they are what lets patterns 6 and 7 route by result and leave the model’s confidence aside.
paragraphs.zh: 上述来源没有一个能够区分失败的调用、格式错误的回复、不明确的判断和逻辑上的未知，也没有一个能让每个模型答案成为可重放的观察结果。 这些是第 2 节中的不变量，也正是它们让模式 6 和模式 7 能够按结果进行路由，而不去理会模型的置信度。

paragraphs.en: Rules that derive every step of a conversation from their state (5) are closest to programmable dialogue rails ( Rebedea et al., 2023 ) , whose flows are written by hand. Recurring model answers that become rules (7) appear only as offline rule extraction. Asking for the evidence that decides between surviving hypotheses (8) is absent from abduction with language models ( Shi et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) . A model that reviews the rules themselves (9) appears in none of the catalogues we read; in all of them the model is the one being checked. The measurements of Section 10 go beyond the validation the catalogues report, which is coverage of literature ( van Harmelen and ten Teije, 2019 ) , redrawing published systems ( de Boer et al., 2025 ) , or a systematic review with known uses ( Liu et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 从其状态（5）推导对话每一步的规则，最接近可编程对话轨道（Rebedea et al., 2023），其流程由人工编写。 反复出现并转化为规则（7）的模型回答，仅以离线规则抽取的形式出现。 要求提供在存留假设（8）之间做出裁决的证据，这一点在基于语言模型的溯因（Shi et al., 2023；Wang et al., 2024）中是缺失的。 由模型审查规则本身（9）的做法，在我们阅读的所有目录中均未出现；在所有这些目录中，模型都是被检查的对象。 第 10 节的测量超出了这些目录所报告的验证，后者即文献覆盖（van Harmelen and ten Teije, 2019）、重绘已发表系统（de Boer et al., 2025），或带有已知用途的系统性综述（Liu et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: Six published patterns have no counterpart, or only an unnamed one; C1 is now named as a variant of the Sensor and C5 has become pattern 11. We rank them by how often they appear and how well they fit the invariants.
paragraphs.zh: 六个已发表的模式没有对应项，或只有未命名的对应项；C1 现在被命名为传感器（Sensor）的一个变体，C5 已成为模式 11。 我们按照它们出现的频率以及它们符合不变式的程度来对它们进行排序。

sents.en: Six published patterns have no counterpart, or only an unnamed one; C1 is now named as a variant of the Sensor and C5 has become pattern 11.
sents.zh: 六个已发表的模式没有对应项，或只有未命名的对应项；C1 现在被命名为传感器（Sensor）的一个变体，C5 已成为模式 11。

sents.en: We rank them by how often they appear and how well they fit the invariants.
sents.zh: 我们按照它们出现的频率以及它们符合不变式的程度来对它们进行排序。

paragraphs.en: Several answers, one rule. Ask several models or samples and let rules adjudicate: agreement, majority with a count, unclear on disagreement. Voting and debate are agent patterns ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , parallelisation by voting is a workflow ( Schluntz and Zhang, 2024 ) , and self-consistency beat multi-agent debate at the same number of answers ( Huang et al., 2024 ) . Three-valued logic suits it: a disagreement is simply unclear . It is now named as a variant of the Sensor ( Section 3.1 ); with its own measurements it may become a pattern of its own.
paragraphs.zh: 多个答案，一条规则。 询问多个模型或多个采样结果，让规则来裁决：一致则采纳，多数则给出计数，不一致则标记为不明确。 投票与辩论是智能体模式（Liu 等，2025），通过投票进行并行化是一种工作流（Schluntz 和 Zhang，2024），而在相同答案数量下，自一致性优于多智能体辩论（Huang 等，2024）。 三值逻辑正适合它：不一致 simply 就是不明确。 它现在被命名为传感器（Sensor）的一种变体（第 3.1 节）；凭借自身的测量，它可能成为一种独立的模式。

sents.en: Several answers, one rule.
sents.zh: 多个答案，一条规则。

sents.en: Ask several models or samples and let rules adjudicate: agreement, majority with a count, unclear on disagreement.

sents.zh: 三值逻辑正适合它：不一致 simply 就是不明确。

sents.zh: 它现在被命名为传感器（Sensor）的一种变体（第 3.1 节）；凭借自身的测量，它可能成为一种独立的模式。

paragraphs.en: Gate and route before the model. Rules decide whether a request may reach a model at all and which model or prompt it goes to: input rails ( Rebedea et al., 2023 ) , routing ( Schluntz and Zhang, 2024 ) . It is implicit in the triage flow, which sends only the careful judgements of emergency signs to the stronger model; it should be named as a variant of pattern 5. Hackathon submissions add a stricter form, a sovereign gatekeeper : a local model and rules decide what may reach an external model, pseudonymise it on the way out and translate it back on the way in, and send nothing when the local side fails. It makes the rules the guard of the data flow between two models, and it is a candidate for a pattern of its own once it is built and measured.
paragraphs.zh: 在模型之前进行门控与路由。 规则决定一个请求是否可以到达模型，以及它去往哪个模型或提示词：输入护栏（Rebedea et al., 2023）、路由（Schluntz and Zhang, 2024）。 它隐含在分诊流程中，该流程只把涉及紧急体征的谨慎判断发送给更强的模型；它应被命名为模式5的一个变体。 黑客松提交作品增加了一种更严格的形式，即主权守门人：由本地模型和规则决定什么可以到达外部模型，在数据发出时进行假名化处理，在数据返回时翻译还原，并且在本地侧失败时不发送任何内容。 它使规则成为两个智能体之间数据流的守卫者，一旦被构建并得到度量，它就有望成为一个独立模式的候选者。

sents.en: Gate and route before the model.
sents.zh: 在模型之前进行门控与路由。

sents.en: Rules decide whether a request may reach a model at all and which model or prompt it goes to: input rails ( Rebedea et al., 2023 ) , routing ( Schluntz and Zhang, 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 规则决定一个请求是否可以到达模型，以及它去往哪个模型或提示词：输入护栏（Rebedea et al., 2023）、路由（Schluntz and Zhang, 2024）。

sents.zh: 它隐含在分诊流程中，该流程只把涉及紧急体征的谨慎判断发送给更强的模型；它应被命名为模式5的一个变体。

sents.en: Hackathon submissions add a stricter form, a sovereign gatekeeper : a local model and rules decide what may reach an external model, pseudonymise it on the way out and translate it back on the way in, and send nothing when the local side fails.
sents.zh: 黑客松提交作品增加了一种更严格的形式，即主权守门人：由本地模型和规则决定什么可以到达外部模型，在数据发出时进行假名化处理，在数据返回时翻译还原，并且在本地侧失败时不发送任何内容。

sents.en: It makes the rules the guard of the data flow between two models, and it is a candidate for a pattern of its own once it is built and measured.

paragraphs.en: Rules evaluate the model. Rules reconstruct or audit what a model concluded: rational reconstruction ( van Bekkum et al., 2021 ) , knowledge graphs for interpretability ( Pan et al., 2024 ) , the agent evaluator ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . The break-even and capability studies are this pattern run offline; online it is the two-channel disagreement listed under pattern 9. It belongs with pattern 10 as grading, or as a pattern of its own. Its labels are cheapest where the truth holds by construction: a fault the code injected, a value read from an exact oracle such as a barcode or a simulator; several hackathon submissions measured this way, which also avoids Circular Evaluation ( Section 8 ).
paragraphs.zh: 规则评估模型。 规则重建或审计模型得出的结论：理性重建（van Bekkum 等，2021）、面向可解释性的知识图谱（Pan 等，2024）、智能体评估器（Liu 等，2025）。 盈亏平衡研究与能力研究就是这一模式离线运行的形式；在线运行时，它就是模式 9 下列出的双通道分歧。 它与模式 10 一样属于评分，或者可以作为独立的一个模式。 当真值由构造本身保证时，其标注成本最低：代码注入的故障、从条形码或模拟器等精确基准（oracle）读取的数值；有多个黑客松参赛作品即采用这种方式度量，这也避免了循环评估（第 8 节）。

sents.en: Rules evaluate the model.
sents.zh: 规则评估模型。

sents.en: Rules reconstruct or audit what a model concluded: rational reconstruction ( van Bekkum et al., 2021 ) , knowledge graphs for interpretability ( Pan et al., 2024 ) , the agent evaluator ( Liu et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 规则重建或审计模型得出的结论：理性重建（van Bekkum 等，2021）、面向可解释性的知识图谱（Pan 等，2024）、智能体评估器（Liu 等，2025）。

sents.zh: 它与模式 10 一样属于评分，或者可以作为独立的一个模式。

sents.en: Its labels are cheapest where the truth holds by construction: a fault the code injected, a value read from an exact oracle such as a barcode or a simulator; several hackathon submissions measured this way, which also avoids Circular Evaluation ( Section 8 ).
sents.zh: 当真值由构造本身保证时，其标注成本最低：代码注入的故障、从条形码或模拟器等精确基准（oracle）读取的数值；有多个黑客松参赛作品即采用这种方式度量，这也避免了循环评估（第 8 节）。

paragraphs.en: Pooled critics. Several critics (rules, a model, a person) behind one controller that merges their findings into the next request ( Kambhampati et al., 2024 ) . A variant of pattern 6.
paragraphs.zh: 池化的批评者。 将多个批评者（规则、模型、人工）置于一个控制器之后，由该控制器将它们的发现合并到下一次请求中（Kambhampati et al., 2024）。这是模式6的一种变体。

sents.en: Pooled critics.
sents.zh: 池化的批评者。

sents.en: Several critics (rules, a model, a person) behind one controller that merges their findings into the next request ( Kambhampati et al., 2024 ) . A variant of pattern 6.
sents.zh: 将多个批评者（规则、模型、人工）置于一个控制器之后，由该控制器将它们的发现合并到下一次请求中（Kambhampati et al., 2024）。这是模式6的一种变体。

paragraphs.en: Rule-governed memory. Retrieval and episodic memory admitted, superseded and cited by rules ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) . It is now Rule-Governed Memory, pattern 11 ( Section 6.1 ), built from the Sensor for storing and Rules Steer the Model for recall; DreamRAG lite implements the storing half, the program of pattern 11 both halves.
paragraphs.zh: 受规则支配的记忆。 检索与情景记忆被规则承认、取代和引用（Liu et al., 2025；Shinn et al., 2023）。 它现在是受规则支配的记忆，即模式 11（第 6.1 节），由用于存储的传感器和“规则引导模型”用于召回构成；DreamRAG lite 实现了存储这一半，模式 11 的完整程序则实现两半。

sents.en: Rule-governed memory.
sents.zh: 受规则支配的记忆。

sents.en: Retrieval and episodic memory admitted, superseded and cited by rules ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) .
sents.zh: 检索与情景记忆被规则承认、取代和引用（Liu et al., 2025；Shinn et al., 2023）。

paragraphs.en: Specification elicitation and the person as participant. The model helps a person state a goal or a specification, and rules check that it is complete ( Kambhampati et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) ; human feedback as a pattern of its own ( Witschel et al., 2020 ) . Here the person is a participant in every pattern; the elicitation is the idea of interviewing an expert under pattern 2.
paragraphs.zh: 规约导引与人作为参与者。 模型帮助人陈述目标或规约，并由规则检查其完整性（Kambhampati et al., 2024；Liu et al., 2025）；人类反馈作为独立的一种模式（Witschel et al., 2020）。 在这里，人是每一种模式中的参与者；导引即是模式 2 中采访专家的思想。

sents.zh: 规约导引与人作为参与者。

sents.en: The model helps a person state a goal or a specification, and rules check that it is complete ( Kambhampati et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) ; human feedback as a pattern of its own ( Witschel et al., 2020 ) .

paragraphs.en: Three families are outside the catalogue on purpose: the model as driver that calls tools (ReAct, Toolformer, Neuro[Symbolic]); rules compiled into the network, Kautz’s Neuro Symbolic {}_{\text{Symbolic}} and the tight integration of d’Avila Garcez and Lamb (2023) ; and training itself.
paragraphs.zh: 以下三类是有意排除在目录之外的：以模型为驱动并调用工具（ReAct、Toolformer、Neuro[Symbolic]）；将规则编译进网络，即 Kautz 的 Neuro Symbolic {}_{\text{Symbolic}}，以及 d'Avila Garcez 和 Lamb（2023）的紧密集成；还有训练本身。

paragraphs.en: Correctness comes from the sound check. In LLM-Modulo, soundness is inherited from the hard critics and completeness depends on the model; a model alone produced executable plans in about 12 % of cases, and back-prompting from a sound validator raised this to 82 % in one domain ( Kambhampati et al., 2024 ) . The same statement holds for patterns 4 and 8.
paragraphs.zh: 正确性来自可靠性检查。 在 LLM-Modulo 中，可靠性继承自硬性批评者，而完备性取决于模型；仅靠模型时大约只有 12% 的情况能生成可执行计划，而在一个领域中，来自可靠验证器的反向提示将这一比例提升到了 82%（Kambhampati et al., 2024）。 同样的结论也适用于模式 4 和模式 8。

sents.en: Correctness comes from the sound check.
sents.zh: 正确性来自可靠性检查。

sents.en: In LLM-Modulo, soundness is inherited from the hard critics and completeness depends on the model; a model alone produced executable plans in about 12 % of cases, and back-prompting from a sound validator raised this to 82 % in one domain ( Kambhampati et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 在 LLM-Modulo 中，可靠性继承自硬性批评者，而完备性取决于模型；仅靠模型时大约只有 12% 的情况能生成可执行计划，而在一个领域中，来自可靠验证器的反向提示将这一比例提升到了 82%（Kambhampati et al., 2024）。

sents.en: The same statement holds for patterns 4 and 8.
sents.zh: 同样的结论也适用于模式 4 和模式 8。

paragraphs.en: Self-correction needs an external signal. Without external feedback, self-correction lowered accuracy, and earlier gains rested on oracle stopping signals ( Huang et al., 2024 ) . The rules are that signal in pattern 6; citing self-refinement ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) as precedent requires this caveat.
paragraphs.zh: 自我纠错需要外部信号。 在没有外部反馈的情况下，自我纠错会降低准确率，而早期的提升依赖于神谕停止信号（Huang et al., 2024）。 规则是该信号出现在模式 6 中；引用自我改进（Madaan et al., 2023；Shinn et al., 2023）作为先例时需要加上这一注意事项。

sents.en: Self-correction needs an external signal.
sents.zh: 自我纠错需要外部信号。

sents.en: Without external feedback, self-correction lowered accuracy, and earlier gains rested on oracle stopping signals ( Huang et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 在没有外部反馈的情况下，自我纠错会降低准确率，而早期的提升依赖于神谕停止信号（Huang et al., 2024）。

sents.zh: 规则是该信号出现在模式 6 中；引用自我改进（Madaan et al., 2023；Shinn et al., 2023）作为先例时需要加上这一注意事项。

paragraphs.en: Judges have known biases, and rules can mitigate them. A strong judge agreed with people about as often as people agreed with each other, but gave the same verdict when two answers were swapped only about two thirds of the time; references and examples reduced the failures ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) . A rule can ask twice in both orders and require agreement, and supply the reference.
paragraphs.zh: 人类评判者存在已知的偏见，而规则可以缓解这些偏见。 一个强大的智能体作为评判者时，与人类意见一致的频率大约相当于人与人之间彼此一致的频率，但当把两个答案交换顺序后，它只有大约三分之二的情况下会给出相同的判定；提供参考文献和示例减少了这类失败（Zheng et al., 2023）。 规则可以按两种顺序各询问两次并要求结果一致，同时提供参考文献。

sents.en: Judges have known biases, and rules can mitigate them.
sents.zh: 人类评判者存在已知的偏见，而规则可以缓解这些偏见。

sents.en: A strong judge agreed with people about as often as people agreed with each other, but gave the same verdict when two answers were swapped only about two thirds of the time; references and examples reduced the failures ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) .

sents.zh: 规则可以按两种顺序各询问两次并要求结果一致，同时提供参考文献。

paragraphs.en: Complementary failures justify division. A solver-backed method and chain-of-thought failed on different cases ( Olausson et al., 2023 ) , which is the condition under which pattern 7 pays.
paragraphs.zh: 互补的失败证明分工的合理性。 一种由求解器支持的方法和思维链在不同的用例上失败（Olausson et al., 2023），这正是模式 7 能发挥作用的前提条件。

paragraphs.en: Safeguards cover known unknowns. A rule safeguard around a model covers only the failures its authors foresaw ( Washizaki et al., 2020 ) ; pair pattern 4 with 8 or 9 where unforeseen failures matter.
paragraphs.zh: 安全防护措施覆盖的是已知的未知问题。 围绕模型的规则型防护措施只能覆盖其作者预见到的失效情况（Washizaki et al., 2020）；在不可预见的失效情况很重要的场景下，应将模式 4 与模式 8 或 9 配合使用。

paragraphs.en: Form and selection. Agent patterns are written with context, problem, forces, solution, consequences tied to quality attributes, known uses and related patterns, and come with a decision model that is not empirically validated ( Liu et al., 2025 ) ; practitioners advise to start with the simplest option and to use evaluator loops only where the criteria are clear ( Schluntz and Zhang, 2024 ) . The modular taxonomy separates elementary from composed patterns ( van Bekkum et al., 2021 ) ; the thirteen patterns here are compositions of four elementary moves (request, receipt, accept, ask), made explicit in Section 2.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 形式与选择。 智能体模式以上下文、问题、力、与质量属性相关联的解决方案、后果、已知应用和相关模式来编写，并附带一个未经实证验证的决策模型（Liu et al., 2025）；实践者建议从最简单的选项开始，仅在标准明确时才使用评估器循环（Schluntz and Zhang, 2024）。 模块化分类法将基本模式与组合模式区分开来（van Bekkum et al., 2021）；此处的十三种模式是四种基本动作（请求、接收、接受、询问）的组合，在第 2.3 节中予以明确说明。

paragraphs.en: A pattern is chosen by the problem it solves and by the forces of the context. For couplings the forces are measurable: how many rules a model would have to apply by itself, whether a reply can be checked, whether the model acts, who must be able to audit the result, and which model is available. This section first asks whether a hybrid is needed at all, then leads from the problem to the patterns, and closes with the measured results the guide rests on. Of the ways to select a pattern that Gamma et al. (1994, sec. 1.7) list, two fit couplings: scanning the intents ( Table 4 ) and starting from the problem one has ( Figs. 14 and 7 ). Following practitioners’ advice, the guide prefers the simplest coupling that meets the requirement ( Schluntz and Zhang, 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 模式的选择取决于它所解决的问题以及所处情境的约束力。 对于耦合而言，这些约束力是可度量的：模型自身需要应用多少规则、回复能否被检验、模型是否执行动作、谁必须能够审计结果，以及有哪些模型可用。 本节首先探讨是否真的需要混合方案，然后从问题引导至模式，最后给出本指南所依据的实测结果。 在 Gamma 等人 (1994, sec. 1.7) 列出的选择模式的方法中，有两种适用于耦合：扫描设计意图（表 4）和从手头的问题出发（图 14 和图 7）。 遵循实践者的建议，本指南优先选择满足要求的最简单耦合（Schluntz and Zhang, 2024）。

sents.zh: 模式的选择取决于它所解决的问题以及所处情境的约束力。

paragraphs.en: A model alone was the better or equal choice in four measured situations, and the guide says so first.
paragraphs.zh: 仅在四种测量情形中，模型本身是更优或同等的选

paragraphs.en: Few rules. In conversations of up to 48 questions, a reasoning model applying the rules in its prompt was not measurably less accurate than the hybrid (58 or more of 60 against 60 of 60); the accuracy break-even lay at 64 questions.
paragraphs.zh: 规则很少。 在最多 48 个问题的对话中，应用其提示词中规则的推理模型在准确率上并未明显低于混合方式（60 题中答对 58 题及以上，对比答对全部 60 题）；准确率的盈亏平衡点位于 64 个问题处。

sents.en: Few rules.
sents.zh: 规则很少。

sents.en: In conversations of up to 48 questions, a reasoning model applying the rules in its prompt was not measurably less accurate than the hybrid (58 or more of 60 against 60 of 60); the accuracy break-even lay at 64 questions.
sents.zh: 在最多 48 个问题的对话中，应用其提示词中规则的推理模型在准确率上并未明显低于混合方式（60 题中答对 58 题及以上，对比答对全部 60 题）；准确率的盈亏平衡点位于 64 个问题处。

paragraphs.en: Easy documents, a strong model. On a clean five-document review, a model alone decided 12 of 12 runs correctly, at 0.28 instead of 0.72 cents and in a third of the time.
paragraphs.zh: 简单文档，强大模型。 在一项包含五份文档的清晰审查任务中，模型单独在 12 次运行中全部 12 次都做出了正确决策，成本为 0.28 美分而非 0.72 美分，且用时仅为三分之一。

sents.en: Easy documents, a strong model.
sents.zh: 简单文档，强大模型。

sents.en: On a clean five-document review, a model alone decided 12 of 12 runs correctly, at 0.28 instead of 0.72 cents and in a third of the time.
sents.zh: 在一项包含五份文档的清晰审查任务中，模型单独在 12 次运行中全部 12 次都做出了正确决策，成本为 0.28 美分而非 0.72 美分，且用时仅为三分之一。

paragraphs.en: Cost alone. Once a provider’s discount on cached input is priced, the hybrid’s cost advantage in conversations disappears; at 64 and 96 questions the two cost about the same.
paragraphs.zh: 仅仅是成本问题。 一旦服务商对缓存输入的折扣被定价后，混合方案在对话中的成本优势就会消失；在 64 和 96 个问题时，两者的成本大致相同。

sents.en: Cost alone.
sents.zh: 仅仅是成本问题。

sents.en: Once a provider’s discount on cached input is priced, the hybrid’s cost advantage in conversations disappears; at 64 and 96 questions the two cost about the same.
sents.zh: 一旦服务商对缓存输入的折扣被定价后，混合方案在对话中的成本优势就会消失；在 64 和 96 个问题时，两者的成本大致相同。

paragraphs.en: A sensor that cannot quote. An 8-billion-parameter open model extracted worse in the hybrid than alone (45 % against 60 %), because a strict quote rule refused correct values.
paragraphs.zh: 一个无法引用的传感器。 一个 80 亿参数的开源模型在混合提取中的表现反而不如单独使用（45% 对 60%），因为严格的引用规则拒绝了正确的数值。

sents.zh: 一个无法引用的传感器。

sents.en: An 8-billion-parameter open model extracted worse in the hybrid than alone (45 % against 60 %), because a strict quote rule refused correct values.
sents.zh: 一个 80 亿参数的开源模型在混合提取中的表现反而不如单独使用（45% 对 60%），因为严格的引用规则拒绝了正确的数值。

paragraphs.en: A hybrid is needed when at least one of the following holds: the decision must come with a proof or an audit trail; the model acts and some actions must never happen; the rules are many or the process is long (from about 64 rules applied in one conversation in our runs); the answer aggregates over many objects (lists, counts, totals); a weaker, local or cheaper model must do the work; or the rules change and the change must be checked before it takes effect.
paragraphs.zh: 当满足以下至少一个条件时，就需要混合方案：决策必须附带证明或审计轨迹；模型会执行动作，而某些动作绝不能发生；规则很多或流程很长（在我们的运行中，一次对话中大约应用了64条规则）；答案需要对大量对象进行聚合（列表、计数、总计）；必须由更弱、本地或更便宜的模型来完成工作；或者规则会发生变化，且变更必须在生效前经过检查。

paragraphs.en: The questions are not exclusive: a triage line answers yes to the first, third and fourth and becomes a composition of 1, 4, 5, 6 and 7. Table 7 gives the same guide as problems, with the force that decides and the caution that the measurements add.
paragraphs.zh: 这些问题并不互斥：一条分诊线对第一、第三和第四个问题回答“是”，并成为问题1、4、5、6和7的组合。 表7以问题的形式给出了同样的指南，并列出起决定作用的力度以及测量所增加的注意事项。

sents.en: The questions are not exclusive: a triage line answers yes to the first, third and fourth and becomes a composition of 1, 4, 5, 6 and 7.
sents.zh: 这些问题并不互斥：一条分诊线对第一、第三和第四个问题回答“是”，并成为问题1、4、5、6和7的组合。

sents.en: Table 7 gives the same guide as problems, with the force that decides and the caution that the measurements add.
sents.zh: 表7以问题的形式给出了同样的指南，并列出起决定作用的力度以及测量所增加的注意事项。

paragraphs.en: The cautions come from pre-registered studies in which designs and criteria were fixed before the runs.
paragraphs.zh: 这些谨慎来自预注册的研究——在这些研究中，设计与评判标准在运行之前就已固定。

paragraphs.en: Synthetic intake protocols of 4 to 96 questions; the hybrid decided 770 of 770 runs correctly; a model applying the rules itself fell to 39 of 60 at 64 questions and 31 of 60 at 96, with 45 of its 50 errors unsafe.
paragraphs.zh: 合成的接诊协议包含 4 至 96 个问题；混合方法在全部 770 次运行中均判定正确；而模型自行应用规则时，在 64 个问题的情形下降至 60 次中的 39 次，在 96 个问题的情形下降至 60 次中的 31 次，其 50 个错误中有 45 个是不安全的。

paragraphs.en: Without reasoning, a model decided 10 of 30 conversations as a pure model and 30 of 30 in the hybrid. On a ladder of six local models from 1 to 70 billion parameters, the hybrid’s floor in single decisions was a 9-billion-parameter model; the pure model had no floor on the ladder, and for it reasoning mattered more than size.
paragraphs.zh: 在无推理的情况下，纯模型在 30 段对话中判对了 10 段，而混合系统则判对了 30 段中的 30 段。 在从 10 亿到 700 亿参数的六个本地模型阶梯中，混合系统在单次决策上的下限相当于一个 90 亿参数的模型；而纯模型在这个阶梯上没有下限，对它而言，推理比模型规模更重要。

sents.en: Without reasoning, a model decided 10 of 30 conversations as a pure model and 30 of 30 in the hybrid.
sents.zh: 在无推理的情况下，纯模型在 30 段对话中判对了 10 段，而混合系统则判对了 30 段中的 30 段。

sents.en: On a ladder of six local models from 1 to 70 billion parameters, the hybrid’s floor in single decisions was a 9-billion-parameter model; the pure model had no floor on the ladder, and for it reasoning mattered more than size.
sents.zh: 在从 10 亿到 700 亿参数的六个本地模型阶梯中，混合系统在单次决策上的下限相当于一个 90 亿参数的模型；而纯模型在这个阶梯上没有下限，对它而言，推理比模型规模更重要。

paragraphs.en: With one seeded fault per artefact, static checks over rules found every structural fault at every size at no model cost; model reviews of code and prompts lost unreachable rules and missing rules as size grew.
paragraphs.zh: 每个工件植入一个故障时，基于规则的静态检查在各规模下均以零模型代价找出了所有结构性故障；而随着规模增大，对代码和提示词的模型审查则漏掉了不可达规则和缺失规则。

paragraphs.en: Five of five drafting runs ended with a rule passing all hidden cases; error messages that name the fix decided how many repairs were needed.
paragraphs.zh: 五次起草运行中有五次最终产出的规则通过了所有隐藏测试用例；能指明修复方法的错误信息决定了所需修复的次数。

paragraphs.en: At 100 agreements, a model alone produced no exact exhaustive list at low effort; the hybrid answered 10 of 10.
paragraphs.zh: 在100次协议的情况下，仅靠模型无法以低工作量产出精确的穷举列表；而混合方法答对了10题中的10题。

paragraphs.en: With an 8-billion-parameter open model, classifying into 77 intents by first choosing a group and then a label, as rules direct, gained 6 points over one prompt with all labels; putting the groups into one prompt instead collapsed.
paragraphs.zh: 在一个 80 亿参数的开源模型中，按照规则先选组、再选标签，将文本分类到 77 个意图，比在单个提示词中包含所有标签的方式高出 6 分；而将所有组放入同一个提示词中则效果崩溃。

paragraphs.en: The literature adds three cautions that the guide follows: correctness is inherited from the sound check ( Kambhampati et al., 2024 ) ; a model’s self-correction without an external signal does not help ( Huang et al., 2024 ) ; and a rule safeguard covers the failures its authors foresaw ( Washizaki et al., 2020 ) .

We drew the catalogue from one engine and its applications and then checked it against the literature. It covers every coupling we have seen so far around a symbolic, offline core, and that does not prove it complete. Patterns 12 and 13 come from hackathon submissions; their figures are taken from result files committed in those repositories, and we have not rerun them. Every pattern up to 11 has a program that ran against a model; the programs of patterns 12 and 13 are checked against recorded receipts only. Patterns 4, 7, 8, 10, 11, 12 and 13 have no FrameX measurement of their own yet, and the measurement of pattern 9 is a pilot on easy cases. Most measurements use synthetic protocols and one model family; the capability ladder mixes model families and reasoning modes. Couplings that need a different kind of core (constraint solving and plan search, probabilistic inference over model scores, differentiable logic inside the model, training itself) are outside the catalogue. The rules can check what such a core produces, as they check any external tool.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从同一个引擎及其应用中提取了该目录，然后对照文献进行了核查。 它涵盖了迄今为止我们在符号化离线核心周围看到的每一种耦合方式，但这并不能证明它已完备。 模式 12 和 13 来自黑客马拉松的参赛作品；其图表取自这些仓库中提交的结果文件，我们并未重新运行。 模式 11 之前的每个模式都有针对某个模型运行过的程序；模式 12 和 13 的程序仅对照已记录的回执进行了核查。 模式 4、7、8、10、11、12 和 13 尚无自己的 FrameX 测量，模式 9 的测量也只是针对简单案例的试点。 大多数测量使用合成协议和单一模型家族；能力阶梯则混合了不同模型家族和推理模式。 需要另一类核心的耦合方式（约束求解与规划搜索、对模型评分的概率推断、模型内部的可微逻辑、训练本身）不在本目录之列。 规则可以核查这类核心产出的结果，正如它们核查任何外部工具一样。

paragraphs.en: Every name a library defines carries its prefix ( sensor# , author# , tr# , ag# , cp# , hy# , cr# , te# , mem# ), so it cannot collide with the program’s own names. What stays with the program is what only the domain knows: the decision of pattern 3, what the actions of pattern 4 do, which cases pattern 7 decides, the tests of pattern 8, the labels of pattern 10. The request fields keep fixed names; a library meant for other sources would make them parameters. The libraries are prototypes in the companion folder and are meant to move into FrameX beside flow.fx .
paragraphs.zh: 库定义的每个名称都带有自己的前缀（sensor#、author#、tr#、ag#、cp#、hy#、cr#、te#、mem#），因此不会与程序自身的名称冲突。 留在程序中的是只有领域才知道的内容：模式3的决策、模式4的动作做什么、模式7判定哪些情形、模式8的测试、模式10的标签。 请求字段保持固定的名称；一个面向其他数据源的库会把它们做成参数。 这些库是配套文件夹中的原型，旨在移入 FrameX 并置于 flow.fx 旁边。
